attributes.name: aggregate_deductible_amount
attributes.description: Annual aggregate cap on the insured's total deductible obligation across all occurrences in the policy period. Once exhausted, the insurer pays subsequent losses without deductible offset.

attributes.name: application_method
attributes.description: Defines how the deductible is applied: per_occurrence, per_claim, per_accident, aggregate (annual), or per_location. Drives claims payment calculations and bordereaux reporting.

attributes.name: buyback_available_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insured has the option to purchase a deductible buyback endorsement to reduce or eliminate the deductible obligation for an additional premium.

attributes.description: Additional premium charged to the insured to buy back (reduce or eliminate) the deductible. Applicable only when buyback_available_flag is True and the insured exercises the option.

attributes.name: cat_peril_type

attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Rating Content; NAIC CAT Reporting Standards; NFIP

attributes.name: deductible_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code identifying this deductible structure, used in policy declarations, bordereaux, and regulatory filings.

attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all deductible and SIR monetary amounts are denominated (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).

attributes.name: deductible_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the deductible record: active (in force), inactive (expired or removed), superseded (replaced by endorsement), or pending (awaiting binding).

attributes.name: deductible_type
attributes.description: Structural classification of the deductible: flat (fixed dollar), percentage (of loss or TIV), split (per-occurrence and aggregate), disappearing (reduces to zero at threshold), or SIR (Self-Insured Retention layer).

attributes.name: defense_inside_sir_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether defense costs (legal fees, investigation) are included within and erode the SIR layer (True) or are paid outside the SIR by the insurer (False).
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Rating Content; NAIC Statutory Reporting

attributes.name: disappearing_max_amount
attributes.description: Loss threshold at which the deductible fully disappears (reduces to zero) in a disappearing deductible structure. Above this amount the insurer pays the full loss.

attributes.name: disappearing_min_amount
attributes.description: Minimum loss threshold below which the full deductible applies in a disappearing (franchise) deductible structure. Below this point the insured bears the full deductible.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this deductible structure becomes binding and applicable to covered losses. Aligns with policy or endorsement effective date.

attributes.name: endorsement_number
attributes.description: Policy endorsement number that introduced or modified this deductible structure. Null if the deductible was established at original policy issuance rather than via endorsement.

attributes.name: erosion_basis
attributes.description: Defines what costs erode (count against) the deductible or SIR: loss_only (indemnity only), loss_and_alae (loss plus Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense), or loss_and_lae (loss plus all LAE).
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Rating Content; NAIC Statutory Reporting; ALAE/LAE Standards

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this deductible structure ceases to apply. Null for open-ended structures; typically aligns with policy expiration or endorsement end date.

attributes.name: flat_amount
attributes.description: Fixed dollar amount the insured must pay per occurrence or per claim before the insurer's obligation begins. Applicable when deductible_type is flat or split.

attributes.name: lob_code
attributes.description: NAIC or internal Line of Business code associated with this deductible (e.g., GL, CGL, BOP, WC, APD, PIP). Supports statutory reporting and actuarial segmentation.
attributes.references: NAIC Statutory Reporting; ISO/Verisk Rating Content

attributes.name: maximum_deductible_amount
attributes.description: Ceiling dollar amount for the deductible, capping the insured's per-occurrence or per-claim obligation even when a percentage calculation yields a higher result.

attributes.name: minimum_deductible_amount
attributes.description: Floor dollar amount for the deductible, ensuring the insured's obligation does not fall below this value even when a percentage calculation yields a lower result.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text underwriting or operational notes describing special conditions, negotiated terms, or exceptions applicable to this deductible or SIR structure.

attributes.name: percentage_basis
attributes.description: The value base against which the percentage deductible is calculated: TIV (Total Insured Value), loss (actual loss amount), SI (Sum Insured), or AAV (Agreed Amount Value).

attributes.name: percentage_rate
attributes.description: Deductible expressed as a percentage (e.g., 2.0000 = 2%) applied to the loss amount, Total Insured Value (TIV), or sum insured. Used when deductible_type is percentage.

attributes.name: rate_credit_factor
attributes.description: Multiplicative premium credit factor applied to the base rate as a result of the insured accepting this deductible or SIR level (e.g., 0.8500 = 15% credit). Used in premium rating.

attributes.name: reinstatement_basis
attributes.description: Defines whether the aggregate deductible or SIR cap reinstates after exhaustion: automatic (reinstates without additional premium), paid (reinstates for additional premium), or none.

attributes.description: Maximum annual aggregate dollar amount the insured is obligated to fund under the SIR layer across all occurrences in the policy period.

attributes.name: sir_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the Self-Insured Retention layer the insured must fully exhaust before the insurer's policy obligations are triggered. Distinct from a deductible in that the insurer has no duty to defend within the SIR.

attributes.description: Monotonically increasing version counter for this deductible record. Increments with each endorsement or modification, enabling point-in-time reconstruction of the deductible structure.

products.reference: Installment Due / Billing Invoice — BillingCenter / Duck Creek Billing

attributes.name: installment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the installment record within the billing schedule.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Individual installment billing requires currency reference for payment processing, exchange rate application, and account reconciliation. Currency_code denormalized, replace with FK.

attributes.name: installment_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent billing schedule that contains this installment.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy for which this installment is billed.

attributes.name: autopay_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this installment is enrolled in automatic payment processing.

attributes.name: billed_amount
attributes.description: Total amount billed for this installment, including premium and fees.

attributes.name: billed_date
attributes.description: Date when the installment invoice was generated and sent to the policyholder.

attributes.name: billing_notice_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a billing notice has been sent to the policyholder for this installment.

attributes.name: cancellation_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the policy will be cancelled if this installment remains unpaid.

attributes.name: cancellation_notice_date
attributes.description: Date when a cancellation notice was issued due to non-payment of this installment.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this installment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: days_overdue
attributes.description: Number of days the installment payment is past the grace period end date.

attributes.name: delinquency_status
attributes.description: Classification of the installment based on payment timeliness and collection status.

attributes.name: due_date
attributes.description: Date by which the installment payment is due from the policyholder.

attributes.name: fee_amount
attributes.description: Total fees charged on this installment (e.g., installment fee, service charge).

attributes.name: grace_period_days
attributes.description: Number of days after due date before the installment is considered overdue.

attributes.name: grace_period_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the grace period expires and the installment becomes overdue.

attributes.name: installment_status
attributes.description: Current payment status of the installment in its lifecycle.

attributes.name: invoice_number
attributes.description: Unique invoice number generated for this installment billing.

attributes.name: late_fee_amount
attributes.description: Late payment fee assessed if installment is paid after the due date.

attributes.name: late_notice_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a late payment notice has been sent for this overdue installment.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Sequential number of this installment within the billing schedule (e.g., 1 of 12).

attributes.name: outstanding_balance
attributes.description: Remaining unpaid balance on this installment (billed amount minus paid amount).

attributes.name: paid_amount
attributes.description: Total amount paid by the policyholder toward this installment to date.

attributes.name: paid_date
attributes.description: Date when the installment was fully paid by the policyholder.

attributes.name: payment_channel
attributes.description: Channel or interface through which the installment payment was received.

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Method or instrument used by the policyholder to pay this installment. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: check|credit_card|debit_card|ach|wire|cash|money_order — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: payment_reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number or transaction ID from the payment processor.

attributes.name: premium_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the installment amount that represents pure insurance premium.

attributes.name: reminder_notice_sent_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a payment reminder notice has been sent for this installment.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date when a payment reversal occurred on this installment.

attributes.name: reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a payment on this installment has been reversed (e.g., chargeback, NSF).

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Reason code or description for why a payment was reversed (e.g., NSF, chargeback, dispute).

attributes.name: tax_amount
attributes.description: Total taxes (e.g., premium tax, surcharges) included in this installment.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this installment record was last modified.

attributes.name: waived_date
attributes.description: Date when the installment was waived or forgiven.

attributes.name: waived_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this installment has been waived or forgiven by the insurer.

attributes.name: waived_reason
attributes.description: Reason or justification for waiving this installment (e.g., customer service, hardship).

products.name: payment
products.description: Records each premium payment received: date, amount, method (check, ACH, card), and any unapplied suspense balance pending policy/account matching. Applied to installments via the payment_application junction.
products.reference: Premium Payment / Cash Receipt — BillingCenter / Oracle AR

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the premium payment transaction record.

attributes.name: billing_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the billing account that made this payment.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Payment transactions must reference currency master for exchange rate application, bank reconciliation, and multi-currency payment processing. Currency_code denormalized, replace with FK.

attributes.name: installment_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the installment or payment plan this payment is associated with.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy for which this premium payment was received.

attributes.name: premium_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier assigned by the payment gateway or processor.

attributes.name: producers_producer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the agent or broker who facilitated or collected the payment.

attributes.name: amount
attributes.description: Total monetary amount received in this payment transaction.

attributes.name: applied_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the payment amount that has been applied to outstanding invoices or installments.

attributes.name: authorization_code
attributes.description: Authorization or approval code returned by the payment processor for card transactions.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution that processed the payment.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: Nine-digit ABA routing number for ACH or wire payments.

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Interface or touchpoint through which the payment was submitted (web portal, mobile app, agent office, mail, phone, branch, lockbox). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: web|mobile|agent|mail|phone|branch|lockbox — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: cleared_date
attributes.description: Date the payment cleared the bank and funds were confirmed available.

attributes.name: convenience_fee_amount
attributes.description: Additional fee charged to the payer for using a specific payment method or channel.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the payment record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: deposit_date
attributes.description: Date the payment was deposited into the insurers bank account.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the payment is effective for premium credit or policy reinstatement purposes.

attributes.name: installment_number
attributes.description: Sequence number of the installment this payment satisfies within the payment plan.

attributes.name: method
attributes.description: Instrument or mechanism used to remit the payment (check, ACH, card, wire, cash). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: check|ach|wire|credit_card|debit_card|cash|money_order — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: modified_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier that last modified the payment record.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the payment record was last modified.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding the payment transaction, exceptions, or special handling.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique payment transaction number or receipt number.

attributes.name: payer_account_number
attributes.description: Masked or tokenized account number from which the payment was drawn (last 4 digits of card or bank account).

attributes.name: payer_name
attributes.description: Name of the individual or entity that remitted the payment.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Date the payment was received or posted to the account.

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment transaction in the billing workflow.

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Classification of the payment purpose (premium, reinstatement, late fee, NSF fee, adjustment, refund).

attributes.name: processing_fee_amount
attributes.description: Fee charged by the payment processor or gateway for handling the transaction.

attributes.name: receipt_issued_date
attributes.description: Date the payment receipt was generated and issued to the payer.

attributes.name: receipt_number
attributes.description: Official receipt number issued to the payer acknowledging the payment.

attributes.name: reference_number
attributes.description: External reference number from the payment processor, bank, or payer (check number, ACH trace, card authorization code).

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Date the payment was reversed or returned, if applicable.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation or code for why the payment was reversed, if applicable (NSF, stop payment, dispute).

attributes.name: source
attributes.description: Origin or category of the payer (policyholder, third party, agent, reinsurer, subrogation recovery).

attributes.name: unapplied_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the payment held in suspense, not yet matched to a policy or account balance.

attributes.name: created_by
attributes.description: User ID or system identifier that created the payment record.

products.name: payment_application
products.description: Junction table resolving the many-to-many relationship between premium payments and installments. Records applied amount, application date, and sequence. Enables full cash application audit trail.

attributes.name: payment_application_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the payment application record. Primary key for the junction table linking premium payments to installments.

attributes.name: installment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the premium installment schedule entry to which the payment is being applied.

attributes.name: payment_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the premium payment transaction that is being applied to one or more installments.

attributes.name: premium_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique transaction identifier from the source billing system. Enables traceability back to the originating system for reconciliation and troubleshooting.

attributes.name: allocation_priority
attributes.description: Numeric priority order used to allocate payment across multiple installments or charge types. Lower numbers applied first per billing rules.

attributes.name: application_date
attributes.description: Business date on which the payment was applied to the installment. May differ from payment received date due to batch processing or suspense clearing.

attributes.name: application_method
attributes.description: Method by which the payment was applied to the installment: automatic system matching, manual CSR allocation, suspense clearing, reversal, or adjustment.

attributes.name: application_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by CSR or system explaining special circumstances of the payment application such as manual allocation reason or suspense research outcome.

attributes.name: application_sequence
attributes.description: Sequential order in which this payment application was processed. Supports audit trail and reversal logic for multi-installment payments.

attributes.name: application_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payment application. Applied is normal state; reversed indicates the application was undone; pending for suspense items.

attributes.name: application_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the payment application transaction was recorded in the billing system. Supports audit and reconciliation.

attributes.name: applied_amount
attributes.description: Monetary amount from the payment that was applied to this specific installment. Sum of all applied amounts for a payment equals the payment total.

attributes.name: applied_by_user_code
attributes.description: User ID of the CSR or system account that executed the payment application. Null for fully automated applications. Supports audit and quality review.

attributes.name: applied_to_fee_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this application was allocated to fees such as late payment fees, NSF fees, or installment fees rather than premium principal.

attributes.name: applied_to_interest_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this application was allocated to accrued interest charges on overdue installments rather than premium principal.

attributes.name: applied_to_principal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this application reduced the principal premium amount. True for standard applications; false for fee or interest applications.

attributes.name: billing_account_number
attributes.description: Billing account number under which the installment and payment are managed. Denormalized for cash application and reconciliation reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment application record was first created in the data warehouse. Supports data lineage and audit trail.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for the applied amount. Typically USD for domestic P&C operations.

attributes.name: installment_balance_after
attributes.description: Outstanding balance of the installment immediately after this payment application. Should equal balance_before minus applied_amount.

attributes.name: installment_balance_before
attributes.description: Outstanding balance of the installment immediately before this payment application. Enables balance reconciliation and audit trail.

attributes.name: nsf_reversal_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this application was reversed due to a returned or dishonored payment such as NSF check or failed ACH. Triggers reinstatement of installment balance.

attributes.name: policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number associated with the installment to which payment is applied. Denormalized for reporting and reconciliation convenience.

attributes.name: reversal_date
attributes.description: Business date on which this payment application was reversed. Null if application remains in effect. Critical for earned premium and cash reconciliation.

attributes.name: reversal_reason_code
attributes.description: Standardized code indicating why this payment application was reversed. Null if application has not been reversed. Used for audit and reporting.

attributes.name: reversal_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the payment application was reversed. Null if not reversed. Supports audit trail and temporal queries.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the billing or payment system that originated this payment application record. Supports multi-system integration and data lineage.

attributes.name: suspense_clearing_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this application cleared a payment from suspense account. True when unidentified payment is matched to installment after research.

attributes.name: unapplied_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the payment that remains unapplied after this application. Tracks suspense balance and supports multi-step application workflows.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this payment application record was last modified in the data warehouse. Tracks changes such as status updates or reversals.

products.name: dac_transaction
products.description: Deferred Acquisition Cost transaction recording capitalized and amortized DAC amounts per policy. Tracks DAC asset balance, amortization schedule, and write-off events per US GAAP ASC 944 and IFRS 17.

attributes.name: dac_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the DAC transaction record.

attributes.name: calendar_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.calendar. Business justification: DAC accounting requires calendar reference for amortization period calculation, financial reporting, and GAAP/IFRS compliance. Accounting_period denormalized, replace with FK.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: DAC accounting in multiple currencies requires currency reference for proper GAAP/IFRS reporting, amortization calculation, and financial consolidation.

attributes.name: lob_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.lob_code. Business justification: DAC transactions require LOB reference for amortization period determination, recoverability testing, and financial reporting by line of business. Lob denormalized, replace with FK.

attributes.name: coverage_policy_coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.coverage_policy_coverage. Business justification: DAC amortization tracks by coverage for GAAP accounting, profitability analysis by coverage type, and recoverability testing.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy for which DAC is capitalized or amortized.

attributes.name: premium_transaction_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier of the transaction in the source system, used for reconciliation and audit trail purposes.

attributes.name: accounting_standard
attributes.description: Accounting standard under which this DAC transaction is recorded: US GAAP ASC 944, IFRS 17, or Statutory Accounting Principles.
attributes.references: US GAAP ASC 944, IFRS 17, NAIC SAP

attributes.name: adjustment_amount
attributes.description: Amount of adjustment to previously recorded DAC, due to policy endorsements, premium adjustments, or actuarial recalculations.

attributes.name: amortization_amount
attributes.description: Amount of DAC amortized in this transaction, expensed over the policy term in proportion to earned premium or expected gross profits.

attributes.name: amortization_method
attributes.description: Method used to amortize DAC: straight-line over policy term, proportional to earned premium, or proportional to expected gross profits per US GAAP ASC 944.

attributes.name: amortization_period_months
attributes.description: Total number of months over which the DAC asset is amortized, typically matching the policy term.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the DAC transaction was approved by an authorized user, part of the financial control workflow.

attributes.name: approved_by_user_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the user who approved this DAC transaction, required for transactions above materiality thresholds per SOX controls.

attributes.name: capitalized_amount
attributes.description: Total acquisition cost amount capitalized as a DAC asset for the policy, including commissions, underwriting expenses, and other deferrable costs.

attributes.name: commission_amount
attributes.description: Commission paid to producers or agents, a primary component of deferrable acquisition costs capitalized as DAC.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Cost center or organizational unit code for financial reporting and expense allocation purposes.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this DAC transaction record was first created in the data warehouse.

attributes.name: dac_balance
attributes.description: Remaining unamortized DAC asset balance after this transaction, representing future expense to be recognized.

attributes.name: earned_premium_amount
attributes.description: Earned premium amount for the period, used as the basis for proportional DAC amortization when amortization method is earned premium.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date from which the DAC transaction becomes effective for financial statement purposes.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General ledger account code to which this DAC transaction is posted in the financial accounting system.
attributes.references: US GAAP, Internal Chart of Accounts

attributes.name: impairment_amount
attributes.description: Amount of DAC impairment recognized if the recoverability test indicates the asset is not recoverable from future profits.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments providing additional context about the DAC transaction, such as special adjustments or manual overrides.

attributes.name: other_acquisition_cost_amount
attributes.description: Other deferrable acquisition costs not classified as commission or underwriting expense, included in DAC capitalization.

attributes.name: policy_effective_date
attributes.description: Effective date of the underlying policy, used to calculate amortization schedules and DAC asset life.

attributes.name: policy_expiration_date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the underlying policy, marking the end of the DAC amortization period.

attributes.name: posted_by_user_code
attributes.description: Identifier of the user or system account that posted this DAC transaction to the financial ledger.

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the specific insurance product associated with this DAC transaction.

attributes.name: recoverability_test_date
attributes.description: Date when the DAC asset recoverability test was last performed to ensure the asset is not impaired per US GAAP ASC 944.

attributes.name: recoverability_test_result
attributes.description: Result of the most recent DAC recoverability test: pass indicates no impairment, fail indicates write-down required.

attributes.name: reversal_reason
attributes.description: Explanation for why a previously posted DAC transaction was reversed, such as data correction, policy cancellation, or accounting error.

attributes.name: transaction_date
attributes.description: Business date when the DAC transaction occurred or was recognized for accounting purposes.

attributes.name: transaction_number
attributes.description: Business-facing unique identifier for the DAC transaction, used in financial reporting and audit trails.

attributes.name: transaction_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the DAC transaction in the financial ledger workflow.

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Type of DAC transaction: capitalization of acquisition costs, amortization over policy term, write-off for lapsed policies, adjustment, or reversal.

attributes.name: underwriting_expense_amount
attributes.description: Underwriting and policy issuance expenses that are deferrable and included in the DAC capitalization.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this DAC transaction record was last modified in the data warehouse.

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: Amount of DAC written off due to policy cancellation, lapse, or other termination event before the end of the policy term.

attributes.name: written_premium_amount
attributes.description: Written premium amount for the policy, used to calculate the DAC capitalization rate and amortization schedule.

products.name: minimum_earned_premium
products.description: Defines the minimum earned premium (MEP) threshold per policy or coverage. Enforces MEP on short-rate cancellations and ensures minimum retained premium per regulatory and contractual requirements.

attributes.name: minimum_earned_premium_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the minimum earned premium threshold record.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: MEP amounts must reference currency for proper calculation, regulatory compliance, and multi-currency policy handling. Currency_code denormalized, replace with FK.

attributes.name: jurisdiction_state_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.state. Business justification: MEP rules are jurisdiction-specific, driven by state regulatory mandates, filing requirements, and cancellation penalty rules. Jurisdiction_code denormalized, replace with FK.

attributes.name: lob_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.lob_code. Business justification: MEP rules vary by LOB for regulatory compliance and risk management. Lob denormalized, replace with FK.

attributes.name: coverage_policy_coverage_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific coverage to which this MEP threshold applies, if coverage-level MEP is enforced.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the policy to which this MEP threshold applies.

attributes.name: applies_to_cancellation_type
attributes.description: Specifies the cancellation types to which this MEP threshold applies: insured-requested, underwriter-initiated, non-payment, or all.
attributes.references: Policy Administration System and State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this MEP threshold record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: The date from which this MEP threshold becomes effective for the policy or coverage.

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: The date on which this MEP threshold expires or is superseded by a new threshold.

attributes.name: filing_approval_date
attributes.description: The date on which the state DOI approved the filing containing this MEP threshold.

attributes.name: filing_reference_number
attributes.description: The regulatory filing reference number under which this MEP threshold was approved by the state DOI.

attributes.name: last_modified_timestamp
attributes.description: The date and time when this MEP threshold record was last updated.

attributes.name: mep_amount
attributes.description: The minimum earned premium amount that must be retained upon policy cancellation or short-rate endorsement.
attributes.references: Policy Contract Terms and State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: mep_calculation_method
attributes.description: The method used to calculate the minimum earned premium: flat amount, percentage of written premium, or the greater of the two.

attributes.name: mep_percentage
attributes.description: The minimum earned premium expressed as a percentage of the total written premium (WP) that must be retained.
attributes.references: Policy Contract Terms and State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: mep_waiver_reason_code
attributes.description: Code representing the reason for waiving or reducing the MEP threshold, if applicable.

attributes.name: minimum_earned_premium_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of this MEP threshold record.

attributes.name: modified_by_user_code
attributes.description: The user ID of the person who last modified this MEP threshold record.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes or comments regarding this MEP threshold, including special conditions or business rationale.

attributes.name: override_allowed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether underwriters are permitted to override this MEP threshold under specific circumstances.

attributes.name: override_authority_level
attributes.description: The minimum authority level required to override this MEP threshold, if overrides are allowed.

attributes.name: policy_term_months
attributes.description: The policy term length in months for which this MEP threshold is defined, if term-specific.

attributes.name: product_code
attributes.description: The insurance product code to which this MEP threshold applies, linking to the product catalog.

attributes.name: regulatory_mandate_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this MEP threshold is mandated by state or federal regulation (true) or is a contractual/company policy (false).
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations and NAIC Guidelines

attributes.name: short_rate_penalty_percentage
attributes.description: The short-rate penalty percentage applied in addition to the MEP when the insured cancels mid-term.
attributes.references: Policy Contract Terms and State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Version number of this MEP threshold record, incremented with each modification for audit trail purposes.

products.name: surplus_lines_tax

attributes.name: currency_id

attributes.name: policy_id

attributes.name: tax_jurisdiction_state_id

attributes.name: adjustment_amount

attributes.name: adjustment_reason

attributes.name: created_timestamp

attributes.name: diligent_search_completed_flag

attributes.name: diligent_search_date

attributes.name: diligent_search_documentation_reference
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the diligent search documentation maintained for regulatory compliance.

attributes.name: exemption_code

attributes.name: exemption_reason

attributes.name: filing_period_end_date

attributes.name: gwp_subject_to_tax

attributes.name: notes

attributes.name: payment_reference_number

attributes.name: penalty_amount

attributes.name: policy_effective_date

attributes.name: stamping_fee_amount

attributes.name: stamping_fee_rate_percent

attributes.name: stamping_office_code

attributes.name: tax_amount

attributes.name: tax_calculation_date

attributes.name: tax_filed_date

attributes.name: tax_filing_due_date
