domains.name: reinsurance
domains.description: Owns RI treaty and facultative (FAC) placements, cession and bordereaux processing, XOL, QS, CAT XL, and CAT Bond structures. Tracks retention/limit layers, ceded premium, ceded loss, and recoverable balances per treaty or certificate.
domains.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting; ACORD Reinsurance Standards; IAIS Reinsurance Supervision Standards

products.name: ri_treaty
products.description: Master record for each reinsurance treaty (XOL, QS, CAT XL, CAT Bond) placed by Pc_Insurance. Captures treaty type, structure, effective/expiry dates, reinsurer panel, retention, limit, and placement status.
products.reference: Reinsurance Treaty Master — SICS / Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: ri_treaty_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each reinsurance treaty or facultative certificate record in the Pc_Insurance reinsurance management system.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which treaty financial terms (retention, limit, premium) are denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: lob_code_id
attributes.description: NAIC or internal Line of Business (LOB) code identifying the class of business covered by the treaty (e.g., GL, WC, APD, Property). [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product]
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Lines of Business; ISO/Verisk

attributes.name: originating_agency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.agency. Business justification: Treaties track originating agency for premium volume aggregation and agency-level profit sharing arrangements.

attributes.name: producers_producer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.producers_producer. Business justification: Treaties specify originating producer codes for subject premium attribution in profit commission calculations and bordereaux reporting.

attributes.name: admitted_reinsurer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer is admitted (licensed) in the cedant's domicile state. Admitted status affects credit for reinsurance on the NAIC statutory balance sheet.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; State DOI; SAP/STAT

attributes.name: aggregate_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum total amount the reinsurer will pay across all occurrences during the treaty period. Applies to aggregate stop-loss and CAT XL treaties with annual aggregate caps.

attributes.name: aggregate_retention_amount
attributes.description: Annual aggregate deductible or retention that must be exhausted before the aggregate reinsurance limit responds. Used in stop-loss and aggregate XOL structures.

attributes.name: am_best_rating
attributes.description: A.M. Best financial strength rating of the lead reinsurer at treaty binding (e.g., A++, A+, A, A-, B++). Used to assess reinsurer credit quality and counterparty risk.
attributes.references: A.M. Best Rating Services; NAIC Schedule F; SAP/STAT

attributes.name: bound_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinsurance treaty was formally bound and agreed upon by all parties, marking the transition from negotiation to a legally binding contract.

attributes.name: broker_commission_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of ceded premium paid to the reinsurance broker as brokerage commission for placing the treaty. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0125 = 1.25%).

attributes.name: broker_name
attributes.description: Name of the reinsurance intermediary broker (e.g., Aon, Guy Carpenter, Willis Re) who placed the treaty on behalf of Pc_Insurance.

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinsurance treaty was cancelled prior to its natural expiry. Null if the treaty was not cancelled.

attributes.name: cat_event_definition
attributes.description: Contractual definition of a catastrophe event for CAT XL treaties, including the hours clause (e.g., 72-hour clause for windstorm) and minimum loss threshold for event aggregation.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk PCS; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; Lloyd's Market Practice

attributes.name: ceded_premium_amount
attributes.description: Total reinsurance premium ceded to the reinsurer panel for the treaty period. Represents the cost of reinsurance protection and is reported on NAIC Schedule F.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/STAT; IFRS 17; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: ceding_commission_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of ceded premium returned to Pc_Insurance by the reinsurer as a ceding commission to offset acquisition and administrative costs. Applicable to QS treaties.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/STAT; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: cession_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of risk ceded to reinsurers under a Quota Share (QS) treaty. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.3000 = 30%). Null for non-QS treaty types.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: collateral_amount
attributes.description: Monetary value of collateral posted by the reinsurer to secure treaty obligations. Required for non-admitted reinsurers to qualify for credit for reinsurance under NAIC rules.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; SAP/STAT; State DOI

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: Type of collateral posted by the reinsurer to secure obligations, required for non-admitted reinsurers under NAIC credit-for-reinsurance rules: LOC, Trust Fund, Funds Withheld, or None.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; SAP/STAT; State DOI

attributes.name: coverage_basis
attributes.description: Defines the trigger basis for reinsurance coverage: Losses Occurring (events during treaty period), Risks Attaching (policies incepting during period), or Claims Made.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the reinsurance treaty record was first created in the reinsurance management system. Used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: deposit_premium_amount
attributes.description: Provisional reinsurance premium paid at treaty inception, subject to adjustment at year-end based on actual subject premium earned. Common in proportional treaties.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; SAP/STAT

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinsurance treaty or facultative certificate becomes effective and coverage obligations commence. Aligns with the treaty inception date in the RI system.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the reinsurance treaty or facultative certificate expires and coverage obligations cease. Null for evergreen or open-ended treaties.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: funds_withheld_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether Pc_Insurance withholds ceded premium funds from the reinsurer under a funds-withheld collateral arrangement, common with non-admitted reinsurers.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/STAT; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: layer_number
attributes.description: Sequential layer number within a multi-layer XOL or CAT XL tower (e.g., Layer 1, Layer 2). Identifies the position of this treaty within the overall reinsurance program structure.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; SICS; Lloyd's Market Practice

attributes.name: lead_reinsurer_name
attributes.description: Name of the lead reinsurer on the treaty panel who sets terms and conditions. The lead reinsurer's agreement is typically required for claims and endorsements.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; Lloyd's Market Practice; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: lead_reinsurer_share_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the treaty limit subscribed by the lead reinsurer. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.2500 = 25% line). Total panel shares must sum to 100%.

attributes.name: limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum monetary amount the reinsurer is obligated to pay under this treaty layer. For XOL, this is the layer width above the retention/attachment point.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; IAIS

attributes.name: loss_corridor_lower_pct
attributes.description: Lower bound of the loss corridor (as a percentage of subject premium) within which Pc_Insurance retains losses in a stop-loss or aggregate structure. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: loss_corridor_upper_pct
attributes.description: Upper bound of the loss corridor (as a percentage of subject premium) above which reinsurance coverage resumes in a stop-loss or aggregate structure. Null if not applicable.

attributes.name: minimum_premium_amount
attributes.description: Minimum reinsurance premium guaranteed to the reinsurer regardless of subject premium volume. Protects the reinsurer against low-volume treaty years.

attributes.name: naic_reinsurer_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Reinsurer Code
attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC company code assigned to the reinsurer, used for statutory Schedule F reporting and regulatory identification of the reinsurance counterparty.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; NAIC Company Database

tag_set.value: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Reinsurer Code

attributes.name: perils_covered
attributes.description: Description of the perils or causes of loss covered by the treaty (e.g., 'All Natural Perils', 'Named Windstorm and Earthquake', 'Fire and Allied Lines'). Free-text or coded.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: placement_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurance placement is a treaty (automatic, portfolio-wide) or facultative (FAC) certificate covering a specific risk or policy.

attributes.name: pml_amount
attributes.description: Probable Maximum Loss (PML) estimate for the subject portfolio covered by this treaty, used to size the reinsurance limit and assess adequacy of protection.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk AIR/RMS CAT Models; A.M. Best; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: profit_commission_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of reinsurer profit returned to Pc_Insurance as a profit commission when the treaty loss ratio falls below a defined threshold. Incentivizes underwriting quality.

attributes.name: profit_commission_threshold_pct
attributes.description: Loss ratio threshold below which the profit commission mechanism is triggered. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.6500 = 65% loss ratio). Null if no profit commission applies.

attributes.name: program_name
attributes.description: Name of the overarching reinsurance program to which this treaty layer belongs (e.g., 'Property CAT Program 2024'). Groups related layers for program-level reporting.

attributes.name: rate_on_line_pct
attributes.description: Rate on Line (ROL) expressed as a percentage of the treaty limit, representing the reinsurance premium as a proportion of the limit purchased. Key pricing metric for XOL treaties.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; Lloyd's Market Practice

attributes.name: reinstatement_count
attributes.description: Number of reinstatements available to restore the treaty limit after a loss occurrence. Common in CAT XL treaties. Zero indicates no reinstatements permitted.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; ISO/Verisk CAT XL Market Practice

attributes.name: reinstatement_premium_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the original reinsurance premium charged to reinstate the treaty limit after a loss. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.0000 = 100% pro-rata reinstatement premium).
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; ISO/Verisk CAT XL Market Practice

attributes.name: retention_amount
attributes.description: The monetary amount or percentage of risk that Pc_Insurance retains before the reinsurance treaty responds. For XOL, this is the per-occurrence or per-risk retention (attachment point).
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; IAIS Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: retention_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the retention is expressed as a fixed monetary amount (e.g., SIR or attachment point in USD) or as a percentage of the risk (used in QS treaties).

attributes.name: subject_premium_basis
attributes.description: Defines the premium base to which the treaty rate or cession percentage is applied: Gross Written Premium (GWP), Net Written Premium (NWP), Earned Premium (EP), or Written Premium (WP).
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP/STAT; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: territory_scope
attributes.description: Geographic scope of risks covered by the treaty (e.g., 'USA and Canada', 'Worldwide Excluding War Zones'). Defines the territorial limits of reinsurance protection.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; ISO/Verisk; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: treaty_name
attributes.description: Descriptive business name of the reinsurance treaty (e.g., 'Property CAT XL Layer 1 2024') used for identification in bordereaux and management reporting.

attributes.name: treaty_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the reinsurance treaty or facultative (FAC) certificate by the reinsurance management system or lead reinsurer.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; SICS; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: treaty_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the reinsurance treaty: DRAFT (in negotiation), BOUND (signed/agreed), ACTIVE (in-force), EXPIRED, CANCELLED, or SUSPENDED.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; SICS; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: treaty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reinsurance structure: Excess of Loss (XOL), Quota Share (QS), Catastrophe Excess of Loss (CAT XL), Facultative (FAC), CAT Bond, Stop Loss, or Aggregate.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk; NAIC Schedule F; IAIS Reinsurance Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the reinsurance treaty record in the reinsurance management system. Supports audit trail and change tracking requirements.

products.name: fac_certificate
products.description: Master record for each facultative (FAC) reinsurance certificate placed on a specific risk or policy. Tracks FAC type, ceded limit, ceded premium, reinsurer, and certificate status independent of treaty structures.

attributes.name: fac_certificate_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each facultative reinsurance certificate record in the Pc_Insurance lakehouse silver layer.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Standards

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which all monetary amounts on this certificate are denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).
attributes.references: ISO 4217; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; IFRS 17

attributes.name: insured_entity_id
attributes.description: Reference to the ceding company (Pc_Insurance entity) placing the facultative risk with the reinsurer.

attributes.name: lob_code_id
attributes.description: NAIC or internal line of business code identifying the class of insurance (e.g., GL, CPP, WC, APD) covered by this facultative certificate.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Line of Business Codes; ISO Verisk

attributes.name: coverage_policy_coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.coverage_policy_coverage. Business justification: Facultative certificates are underwritten against specific high-value coverages (not just policies).

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying primary insurance policy for which this facultative certificate provides reinsurance coverage.

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurer (counterparty) accepting the ceded risk under this facultative certificate.

attributes.name: risk_unit_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific insured risk or scheduled item being ceded under this facultative certificate.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; ISO Verisk Rating Content

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: Financial accounting period (YYYY-MM) to which ceded premium and loss transactions on this certificate are posted in the general ledger.
attributes.references: Oracle Financials GL; SAP FI; SAP/STAT; IFRS 17; US GAAP FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: authorized_reinsurer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer is authorized/accredited in the cedant's domicile state, affecting statutory credit for reinsurance on Schedule F.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; State DOI Licensing; NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law

attributes.name: bordereaux_period
attributes.description: Reporting period (YYYY-MM or YYYY-Q#) in which this certificate is included in the bordereaux submission to the reinsurer.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; IAIS Reinsurance Supervision

attributes.name: bound_date
attributes.description: Date on which the facultative certificate was formally bound and accepted by the reinsurer, establishing the contractual obligation.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Standards

attributes.name: cancellation_date
attributes.description: Date on which the facultative certificate was cancelled prior to its scheduled expiry, if applicable.

attributes.name: cat_exposed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the risk ceded under this certificate is exposed to catastrophe (CAT) perils such as hurricane, earthquake, or flood.
attributes.references: ISO Verisk CAT Modeling; NAIC CAT Reporting; AIR/RMS Catastrophe Models

attributes.name: ceded_alae_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Ceded Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) Amount
attributes.description: Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) ceded to the reinsurer under this certificate, per treaty or certificate terms.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; SAP/STAT

tag_set.value: Ceded Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) Amount

attributes.name: ceded_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum reinsurance recovery amount the reinsurer is liable for under this facultative certificate, expressed in the certificate currency.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: ceded_loss_amount
attributes.description: Total loss amount ceded to the reinsurer under this certificate, representing the reinsurer's share of paid and reserved losses.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: ceded_retention_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of loss retained by the cedant before the reinsurer's liability attaches under this facultative certificate.

attributes.name: ceded_share_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the original risk ceded to the reinsurer under this certificate. Applicable for proportional (QS/surplus) arrangements.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: ceding_commission_amount
attributes.description: Absolute dollar amount of ceding commission receivable from the reinsurer, derived from ceding_commission_pct applied to gross_ceded_premium.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; SAP/STAT

attributes.name: ceding_commission_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of ceded premium returned to the cedant as ceding commission to offset acquisition and administrative costs.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; SAP/STAT

attributes.name: certificate_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to the facultative certificate by the reinsurer or cedant, used in bordereaux and correspondence.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: certificate_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the facultative certificate from placement through expiry or cancellation.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Standards

attributes.name: collateral_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of collateral posted by the reinsurer to secure the cedant's reinsurance recoverable under this certificate.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: collateral_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer is required to post collateral (trust, LOC, funds withheld) due to unauthorized status or credit terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; State DOI; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: Type of collateral posted by the reinsurer to secure recoverable obligations: trust fund, letter of credit, funds withheld, or none.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; NAIC Schedule F; State DOI

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this facultative certificate record was first created in the system of record, used for audit trail and data lineage.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NIST SP 800-53; Databricks Lakehouse Audit Standards

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the facultative certificate expires and reinsurance coverage ceases. Null for open-ended certificates.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: fac_type
attributes.description: Classification of the facultative arrangement: proportional (quota share, surplus) or non-proportional (excess of loss). Drives cession calculation methodology.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Reporting Standards; ISO Verisk; IAIS Reinsurance Supervision

attributes.name: gross_ceded_premium
attributes.description: Gross Written Premium (GWP) ceded to the reinsurer under this certificate before deduction of ceding commission.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17; SAP/STAT

attributes.name: inception_date
attributes.description: Date on which the facultative certificate becomes effective and reinsurance coverage commences.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17

attributes.name: insured_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the insured party on the underlying policy, included on the facultative certificate for risk identification purposes.

attributes.name: net_ceded_premium
attributes.description: Net Written Premium (NWP) ceded to the reinsurer after deducting ceding commission from gross ceded premium.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; IFRS 17; SAP/STAT

attributes.name: original_tiv
attributes.description: Total Insured Value of the underlying risk at the time of facultative placement, used to size the ceded limit and premium.
attributes.references: ISO Verisk; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Property Reporting

attributes.name: placement_broker
attributes.description: Name of the reinsurance intermediary or broker who facilitated the placement of this facultative certificate in the market.

attributes.name: pml_amount
attributes.description: Probable Maximum Loss (PML) estimate for the ceded risk, used to size the facultative limit and assess reinsurer exposure.
attributes.references: ISO Verisk; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Property Reporting

attributes.name: recoverable_balance
attributes.description: Outstanding reinsurance recoverable amount owed by the reinsurer to the cedant for ceded losses not yet collected.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; SAP/STAT; IFRS 17

attributes.name: risk_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the underlying insured risk being ceded, including COPE (Construction, Occupancy, Protection, Exposure) details for property risks.
attributes.references: ISO Verisk COPE Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: rol_pct
attributes.description: Rate on Line (ROL) expressed as a percentage of the ceded limit, used to price non-proportional (XOL) facultative certificates.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; ISO Verisk; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this facultative certificate record was ingested into the lakehouse.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster (SICS); Guidewire PolicyCenter; Duck Creek Policy

attributes.name: underwriter_name
attributes.description: Name of the cedant's underwriter responsible for placing and managing this facultative certificate.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this facultative certificate record, supporting change tracking and incremental ETL processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NIST SP 800-53; Databricks Lakehouse Audit Standards

attributes.name: xol_attachment_point
attributes.description: Loss amount at which the reinsurer's liability attaches under an excess of loss (XOL) facultative arrangement. Null for proportional certificates.

attributes.name: xol_exhaustion_point
attributes.description: Loss amount at which the reinsurer's layer is fully exhausted under an XOL facultative arrangement (attachment + limit).

products.name: treaty_layer
products.description: Defines each retention/limit layer within a treaty (e.g., first XOL layer, second XOL layer, QS tranche). Stores attachment point, limit, ROL, and layer sequence for multi-layer treaty structures.

attributes.name: treaty_layer_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each retention/limit layer record within a reinsurance treaty or facultative certificate structure.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; SICS Reinsurance Management System

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for all monetary amounts on this layer (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR). Supports multi-currency treaty structures.
attributes.references: ISO 4217 Currency Codes; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; IFRS 17

attributes.name: insured_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_location. Business justification: Treaty layers (especially CAT XOL) are priced against location exposure schedules.

attributes.name: lob_code_id
attributes.description: NAIC or internal Line of Business code identifying the class of business covered by this treaty layer (e.g., Commercial Auto, GL, Property, WC). Supports statutory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Line of Business Codes; ISO/Verisk; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP)

attributes.name: ri_treaty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent reinsurance treaty or facultative certificate to which this layer belongs.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; SICS Reinsurance Management System

attributes.name: adjusted_premium
attributes.description: Final reinsurance premium after year-end adjustment reconciling deposit premium against actual subject premium earned. Reflects true cost of the layer for the period.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP); Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: aggregate_annual_limit
attributes.description: Maximum total reinsurer liability across all occurrences within the treaty year for this layer. Caps cumulative reinsurer exposure on aggregate XOL structures.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Aggregate XOL Standards; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: aggregate_deductible
attributes.description: Cumulative loss amount the cedant must retain before the aggregate XOL layer responds. Used in aggregate stop-loss and aggregate XOL treaty structures.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Aggregate XOL Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: alae_included
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) Included Indicator
attributes.description: Indicates whether Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) is included within the layer limit and attachment point calculations for this treaty layer.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP); Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

tag_set.value: Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) Included Indicator

attributes.name: attachment_point
attributes.description: The loss amount at which this reinsurance layer begins to respond. For XOL structures, losses must exceed this threshold before the reinsurer pays. Also known as the retention.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk XOL Structuring Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: cat_event_limit
attributes.description: Maximum reinsurer liability per defined catastrophe event under a CAT XL layer. Distinct from per-risk occurrence limit; applies to accumulation of losses from a single CAT event.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk CAT Modeling Standards; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: ceding_commission_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of ceded premium returned to the cedant by the reinsurer as a ceding commission to cover acquisition and administrative costs on QS treaties.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP); Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: cession_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of risk ceded to reinsurers under a Quota Share (QS) layer. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.3000 = 30%). Applicable to QS and proportional treaty structures.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP); Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this treaty layer record was first created in the reinsurance management system. Supports audit trail and data lineage requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Data Governance Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: deposit_premium
attributes.description: Provisional premium paid to the reinsurer at inception of the treaty period, subject to adjustment at year-end based on actual subject premium earned.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP)

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this treaty layer becomes operative and eligible to accept ceded risk and premium.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Accounting Standards; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP)

attributes.name: exclusions_summary
attributes.description: Free-text summary of key exclusions applicable to this layer (e.g., nuclear, cyber, war, NBCR). Supports underwriting review and reinsurer communication.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Reinsurance Wording Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: exhaustion_point
attributes.description: The loss level at which this layer is fully exhausted, calculated as attachment point plus layer limit. Marks the top of the layer in the reinsurance tower.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Reinsurance Structuring Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which this treaty layer ceases to be operative. Null for evergreen or continuous treaty layers.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Accounting Standards; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP)

attributes.name: hours_clause
attributes.description: Number of consecutive hours defining the event window for CAT XL loss aggregation. Losses occurring within this window are treated as a single occurrence (e.g., 72 or 168 hours).
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk CAT XL Structuring Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: index_base_year
attributes.description: The reference year used as the base for the index or stability clause adjustment. Applicable only when index_clause is true.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Reinsurance Structuring Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: index_clause
attributes.description: Indicates whether an index or stability clause applies to this layer, adjusting the attachment point and limit for inflation over the treaty period.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Reinsurance Structuring Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: lae_treatment
attributes.description: Specifies how LAE is handled within this layer. INCLUDED=LAE erodes the limit, EXCLUDED=LAE outside limit, PRO_RATA=LAE shared proportionally with losses.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP); ISO/Verisk

attributes.name: layer_limit
attributes.description: Maximum amount the reinsurer will pay for losses within this layer per occurrence or per risk. Defines the top of the layer in the XOL tower.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk XOL Structuring Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: layer_name
attributes.description: Descriptive business name for the layer (e.g., 'First XOL Layer', 'QS Tranche A', 'CAT XL Working Layer') used in bordereaux and reinsurer communications.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; SICS Reinsurance Management System

attributes.name: layer_number
attributes.description: Sequential position of this layer within the treaty structure (e.g., 1 = first XOL layer, 2 = second XOL layer). Drives ordering in multi-layer tower analysis.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Reinsurance Structuring Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: layer_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the treaty layer. Drives whether cessions and premium calculations are applied against this layer.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: layer_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reinsurance layer structure. XOL=Excess of Loss, QS=Quota Share, CAT XL=Catastrophe Excess of Loss, FAC=Facultative, AGGREGATE_XL=Aggregate Excess of Loss.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Accounting Standards; ISO/Verisk; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: loss_basis
attributes.description: Trigger basis determining how losses are measured and applied to this layer. OCCURRENCE=per event, RISK=per insured risk, AGGREGATE=cumulative annual, CLAIMS_MADE=claims-made trigger.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Reinsurance Structuring Standards; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: max_ceding_commission_pct
attributes.description: Ceiling ceding commission rate applicable under a sliding scale commission arrangement. The cedant receives at most this rate when loss ratio is at its lowest.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP)

attributes.name: min_ceding_commission_pct
attributes.description: Floor ceding commission rate applicable under a sliding scale commission arrangement. The cedant receives at least this rate regardless of loss ratio.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP)

attributes.name: minimum_premium
attributes.description: Minimum reinsurance premium guaranteed to the reinsurer for this layer regardless of subject premium volume. Protects reinsurer against low-volume treaty years.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP)

attributes.name: occurrence_limit
attributes.description: Maximum reinsurer liability per single occurrence or event under this layer. Distinct from the aggregate annual limit. Applies to per-occurrence XOL and CAT XL structures.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk XOL Structuring Standards; NAIC Schedule F; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: pml_basis
attributes.description: Basis used to size the layer relative to the cedant's exposure. PML=Probable Maximum Loss, TIV=Total Insured Value, EML=Estimated Maximum Loss, MFL=Maximum Foreseeable Loss.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk PML Standards; A.M. Best Reinsurance Adequacy; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: profit_commission_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of reinsurer profit returned to the cedant as a profit commission under proportional QS layers. Incentivizes cedant loss control.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP)

attributes.name: reinstatement_count
attributes.description: Number of reinstatements available for this layer after a loss exhausts the limit. Common in CAT XL structures where one or two reinstatements are negotiated.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk CAT XL Structuring Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: reinstatement_premium_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the original layer premium charged to reinstate the full limit after a loss. Expressed as a decimal (e.g., 1.0000 = 100% pro-rata reinstatement).
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk CAT XL Structuring Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: reinsurance_premium
attributes.description: Gross premium ceded to reinsurers for this layer for the treaty period. For XOL layers, derived from ROL times limit; for QS, from cession percentage times subject premium.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP); IFRS 17

attributes.name: rol
attributes.description: Rate on Line expressed as a decimal fraction of the layer limit. Used to price non-proportional XOL and CAT XL layers. ROL multiplied by limit yields the reinsurance premium.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Rating Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; A.M. Best Reinsurance Pricing

attributes.name: signed_line_pct
attributes.description: Total percentage of the layer capacity that has been signed by reinsurers at placement. Should sum to 100% for a fully placed layer. Tracks placement completeness.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; SICS Reinsurance Management System; Lloyd's Market Standards

attributes.name: sliding_scale_commission
attributes.description: Indicates whether the ceding commission on this QS layer is subject to a sliding scale that varies inversely with the loss ratio, rewarding better underwriting performance.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F; ISO/Verisk

attributes.name: subject_premium_basis
attributes.description: Premium base used to calculate ceded premium for proportional layers. GWP=Gross Written Premium, NWP=Net Written Premium, EP=Earned Premium, WP=Written Premium.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP); Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: territorial_scope
attributes.description: Geographic territory covered by this treaty layer (e.g., 'USA', 'USA and Canada', specific state codes). Defines the geographic boundary of reinsurer liability.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; ISO/Verisk; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: treaty_year
attributes.description: The underwriting or treaty year to which this layer belongs. Used for bordereaux processing, IBNR development, and year-of-account statutory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP); IFRS 17

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this treaty layer record. Used for change tracking, audit compliance, and incremental data pipeline processing.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NAIC Data Governance Standards; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: written_line_pct
attributes.description: Percentage of the layer capacity initially offered and written by reinsurers before signing. May differ from signed line if the market is oversubscribed or undersubscribed.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; Lloyd's Market Standards; SICS Reinsurance Management System

products.name: reinsurer
products.description: Master record for each reinsurance counterparty (reinsurer or retrocessionaire). Captures legal name, NAIC code, A.M. Best rating, domicile, authorized status, and credit limit for counterparty risk management.

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each reinsurance counterparty record in the Pc_Insurance reinsurance management system.

attributes.name: am_best_outlook
attributes.description: A.M. Best rating outlook indicating the expected direction of the reinsurer's financial strength rating over the medium term.

attributes.name: am_best_rating
attributes.description: A.M. Best Financial Strength Rating (FSR) assigned to the reinsurer (e.g., A++, A+, A, A-, B++). Used to assess counterparty credit quality and treaty eligibility.
attributes.references: A.M. Best Rating Methodology; Internal Reinsurance Credit Policy

attributes.name: am_best_rating_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current A.M. Best Financial Strength Rating was assigned or last affirmed, used to assess rating currency for treaty approval.
attributes.references: A.M. Best Rating Methodology; Internal Reinsurance Credit Policy

attributes.name: approved_lob_list
attributes.description: Comma-delimited list of Lines of Business (LOB) for which this reinsurer is approved to accept cessions (e.g., GL, WC, APD, CAT XL). Governs treaty eligibility.
attributes.references: Internal Reinsurance Placement Guidelines; NAIC Annual Statement LOB Codes

attributes.name: authorized_status
attributes.description: Regulatory authorization status of the reinsurer in the cedant's domicile state, determining credit-for-reinsurance treatment under NAIC model law.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law #785; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: bank_account_reference
attributes.description: Internal reference code for the reinsurer's designated bank account used for premium and loss settlement, stored as a tokenized reference to the financial system.
attributes.references: PCI DSS; SOX Section 302; Oracle Financials AP

attributes.name: claims_contact_email
attributes.description: Email address of the reinsurer's claims department or designated claims contact for loss notification and recovery correspondence.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; Internal Claims Recovery Policy

attributes.name: class
attributes.description: Broad classification of the reinsurer by organizational class: professional reinsurer, captive, government-sponsored, Lloyd's syndicate, or industry pool.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; A.M. Best Rating Methodology

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: Type of collateral arrangement in place with this reinsurer to secure recoverable balances: none, letter of credit, trust fund, funds withheld, or cash deposit.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law #785; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: counterparty_type
attributes.description: Classification of the reinsurance counterparty indicating its structural role: reinsurer, retrocessionaire, captive, pool, Lloyd's syndicate, or fronting carrier.
attributes.references: NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; IAIS Supervisory Standards

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the reinsurer master record was first created in the system, in ISO 8601 format with timezone offset.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302; NIST SP 800-53 Audit Controls

attributes.name: credit_limit_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code in which the reinsurer credit limit is denominated (e.g., USD, GBP, EUR).

attributes.name: credit_limit_usd
attributes.description: Maximum aggregate ceded exposure in USD that Pc_Insurance is authorized to place with this reinsurer across all treaties and facultative certificates.
attributes.references: Internal Counterparty Credit Risk Policy; NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law

attributes.name: domicile_country
attributes.description: ISO 3166-1 alpha-3 country code of the jurisdiction where the reinsurer is legally domiciled and holds its primary insurance license.
attributes.references: ISO 3166-1; NAIC Reinsurance Model Law; IAIS Core Principles

attributes.name: domicile_state
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code of the reinsurer's state of domicile for domestic reinsurers, used in NAIC statutory reporting and credit-for-reinsurance determinations.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: fein
attributes.description: IRS-issued Federal Employer Identification Number (FEIN) for the reinsurer entity, used in tax reporting and financial settlement.

attributes.name: funds_withheld_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether this reinsurer is eligible for funds-withheld collateral arrangements as an alternative to letters of credit for credit-for-reinsurance purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law #785; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: last_review_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent periodic counterparty credit and compliance review conducted by the reinsurance or risk management team.
attributes.references: Internal Counterparty Credit Risk Policy; SOX Section 302

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal registered name of the reinsurance counterparty as filed with the domicile regulator and used in treaty and facultative contracts.
