attributes.description: Type of reinsurance treaty structure. Applicable for treaty placements; null for facultative.

attributes.name: underwriter_name
attributes.description: Name of the cedant underwriter responsible for managing the placement process and reinsurer relationships.

products.name: occurrence_loss
products.description: Aggregates losses from multiple claims into a single occurrence for XOL treaty application. Stores occurrence date, peril, total gross loss, total ceded loss, applicable treaty layer, and hours clause compliance flag.

attributes.name: occurrence_loss_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the occurrence loss record. Primary key for occurrence-based loss aggregation used in Excess of Loss (XOL) treaty application.

attributes.name: bordereaux_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the bordereaux submission in which this occurrence loss was reported to reinsurers.

attributes.name: cat_event_id
attributes.description: FK to reservespayments.cat_event.cat_event_id — Designates reservespayments.cat_event the single catastrophe master so XOL/CAT XL occurrence aggregation rolls up to the same catastrophe event as claims and reserves.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO currency code for all monetary amounts in this occurrence loss record.

attributes.name: fac_certificate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.fac_certificate. Business justification: Occurrence losses can be ceded under FAC certificates, not just treaties. Currently only has ri_treaty_id. This FK enables tracking FAC-based occurrence cessions.

attributes.name: insured_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_location. Business justification: Catastrophe occurrence losses must identify affected locations for hours clause validation (168-hour rule), PML comparison, and reinstatement trigger determination.

attributes.name: lob_code_id
attributes.description: Code identifying the primary line of business affected by the occurrence, used for treaty layer allocation and cession calculation.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Line of Business Codes

attributes.name: ri_treaty_id
attributes.description: Identifier of the primary reinsurance treaty applied to this occurrence for cession calculation and recovery.

attributes.name: treaty_layer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.treaty_layer. Business justification: Occurrence losses apply to specific treaty layers. Currently has treaty_layer_number (INT), should have proper FK to treaty_layer for full layer definition access.

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: Accounting period in which this occurrence loss is recognized for statutory and GAAP reporting purposes.

attributes.name: attachment_point
attributes.description: Treaty layer attachment point amount at which reinsurance coverage begins for this occurrence under XOL treaty terms.

attributes.name: cat_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether this occurrence qualifies as a catastrophe event under treaty definitions and triggers CAT XOL coverage.

attributes.name: cession_date
attributes.description: Date when the occurrence loss was formally ceded to reinsurers under the applicable treaty terms.

attributes.name: claim_count
attributes.description: Total number of individual claims aggregated into this occurrence loss record for treaty cession purposes.

attributes.name: country_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO country code identifying the country where the occurrence event occurred.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this occurrence loss record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: exhaustion_point
attributes.description: Treaty layer exhaustion point amount at which reinsurance coverage ends for this occurrence, representing the upper limit of the layer.

attributes.name: finalized_date
attributes.description: Date when the occurrence loss record was closed and finalized, with no further claim additions or loss development expected.

attributes.name: geographic_region
attributes.description: Geographic area or territory where the occurrence event took place, used for treaty territory scope validation.

attributes.name: hours_clause_compliant_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether all claims aggregated into this occurrence fall within the treaty hours clause time window for valid occurrence treatment.

attributes.name: hours_clause_duration
attributes.description: Number of hours specified in the treaty hours clause for aggregating related losses into a single occurrence event.

attributes.name: layer_limit_amount
attributes.description: Maximum reinsurance recovery available from the treaty layer for this occurrence, calculated as exhaustion point minus attachment point.

attributes.name: net_loss_amount
attributes.description: Net loss amount retained by the cedant after reinsurance cession, calculated as gross loss minus ceded loss.

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-form text notes providing additional context, special handling instructions, or commentary about the occurrence loss.

attributes.name: occurrence_date
attributes.description: Date when the loss occurrence event took place. Critical for treaty layer attachment and hours clause determination.

attributes.name: occurrence_end_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when the occurrence event concluded, used to determine the duration window for aggregating related claims under hours clause provisions.

attributes.name: occurrence_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name or title assigned to the occurrence event, typically used for catastrophic events or major loss incidents.

attributes.name: occurrence_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the occurrence event. Externally-known reference number used in reinsurance bordereaux and treaty reporting.

attributes.name: occurrence_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the occurrence loss record in the reinsurance cession workflow.

attributes.name: occurrence_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time when the occurrence event began, used for hours clause compliance verification in catastrophe treaties.

attributes.name: peril_code
attributes.description: Standardized code identifying the type of peril that caused the occurrence loss, such as hurricane, earthquake, fire, or flood.

attributes.name: peril_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the peril or cause of loss for the occurrence event.

attributes.name: policy_count
attributes.description: Total number of distinct policies affected by this occurrence event, used for exposure analysis and treaty reporting.

attributes.name: reinstatement_premium_amount
attributes.description: Reinstatement premium amount due to reinsurers as a result of this occurrence loss exhausting or reducing treaty layer capacity.

attributes.name: reinstatement_triggered_flag
attributes.description: Indicator whether this occurrence loss triggered a treaty layer reinstatement, requiring additional reinstatement premium payment.

attributes.name: reported_date
attributes.description: Date when the occurrence loss was first reported to the reinsurance department for cession processing.

attributes.name: retention_amount
attributes.description: Cedant retention amount applied to this occurrence under the applicable treaty terms, representing the portion of loss retained by the ceding company.

attributes.name: state_province_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the state or province where the occurrence event took place, used for regulatory and treaty reporting.

attributes.name: total_ceded_alae_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Ceded Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) Amount
attributes.description: Total ALAE amount ceded to reinsurers for this occurrence under applicable treaty terms.

tag_set.value: Total Ceded Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) Amount

attributes.name: total_ceded_amount
attributes.description: Total amount ceded to reinsurers for this occurrence including loss and ALAE, representing the full reinsurance recovery.

attributes.name: total_ceded_loss_amount
attributes.description: Total loss amount ceded to reinsurers for this occurrence after applying retention and treaty layer limits.

attributes.name: total_gross_alae_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Gross Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) Amount
attributes.description: Total gross Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense aggregated from all claims in this occurrence, before reinsurance recovery.

tag_set.value: Total Gross Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) Amount

attributes.name: total_gross_incurred_amount
attributes.description: Total gross incurred loss including indemnity, ALAE, and ULAE for this occurrence, representing the full exposure before reinsurance.

attributes.name: total_gross_loss_amount
attributes.description: Total gross loss amount aggregated from all claims associated with this occurrence, before any reinsurance cession or retention deduction.

attributes.name: total_gross_ulae_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Total Gross Unallocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ULAE) Amount
attributes.description: Total gross Unallocated Loss Adjustment Expense allocated to this occurrence based on company methodology.

tag_set.value: Total Gross Unallocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ULAE) Amount

attributes.name: treaty_year
attributes.description: Treaty year under which this occurrence loss is covered, used for multi-year treaty accounting and aggregate limit tracking.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time when this occurrence loss record was last modified, used for audit trail and data lineage tracking.

domains.name: riskexposure
domains.description: Provisional description for user-specified domain 'risk_exposure'. Awaiting a generated description of what this domain owns.

products.name: insured_location
products.description: Master SSOT for a physical premises or location insured under a P&C policy. Captures address, COPE attributes, occupancy, TIV, protection class, and geocode.

attributes.name: insured_location_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the insured location record. Primary key for the insured_location master resource in the riskexposure domain.

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.country. Business justification: International exposures require country-level risk assessment for sanctions screening, reinsurance domicile rules, catastrophe modeling (country-specific perils), and regulatory jurisdiction

attributes.name: state_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.state. Business justification: Every insured location must be classified by state for territorial rating, premium tax calculation, regulatory compliance (state DOI jurisdiction), and catastrophe exposure analysis.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address of the insured location (street number and street name). Used for risk geocoding, protection class lookup, and regulatory filings.
attributes.references: USPS Postal Addressing Standards; ISO/Verisk COPE; NAIC Statutory Reporting

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address detail for the insured location such as suite, unit, floor, or building number. Supplements address_line1 for precise premises identification.
attributes.references: USPS Postal Addressing Standards; ISO/Verisk COPE

attributes.name: alarm_type
attributes.description: Type of burglar or fire alarm system at the insured location. Central station and direct-to-fire alarms qualify for rating credits under ISO protective device schedules.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Protective Device Credits; ISO Commercial Lines Manual

attributes.name: building_value
attributes.description: Insured replacement cost or actual cash value of the building structure at this location, excluding contents and business income. Component of TIV used in property rating.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Property Rating; Guidewire PolicyCenter; Duck Creek Rating

attributes.name: business_income_value
attributes.description: Insured value for business income and extra expense coverage at this location. Represents maximum indemnity for lost revenue following a covered loss event.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Business Income Coverage Form; Guidewire PolicyCenter

attributes.name: cat_zone
attributes.description: Insurer-defined CAT accumulation zone code for the insured location. Used for CAT XL reinsurance treaty management, PML aggregation, and exposure accumulation reporting.
attributes.references: AIR/RMS CAT Modeling; ISO/Verisk CAT Zone Definitions; Reinsurance Treaty Terms

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City or municipality in which the insured location is situated. Used for territory rating, regulatory jurisdiction assignment, and CAT zone mapping.
attributes.references: USPS Postal Addressing Standards; ISO/Verisk Territory Rating

attributes.name: construction_type
attributes.description: ISO construction class of the insured building per COPE framework. Drives fire and wind rating factors. Frame is highest risk; fire_resistive is lowest. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product if additional ISO classes needed]
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk COPE Construction Classes; ISO Commercial Lines Manual

attributes.name: contents_value
attributes.description: Insured value of business personal property and contents at this location. Separate from building value; used for contents coverage rating and TIV accumulation.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Property Rating; Guidewire PolicyCenter; Duck Creek Rating

attributes.name: county
attributes.description: County or parish in which the insured location is situated. Used for NFIP flood zone mapping, CAT modeling, and certain state-specific rating territories.
attributes.references: FIPS County Codes; NFIP Flood Zone Mapping; ISO/Verisk

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the insured location record was first created in the system of record. Used for data lineage, audit trail, and regulatory compliance tracking.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; NAIC Data Governance; Guidewire PolicyCenter Audit

attributes.name: distance_to_coast_miles
attributes.description: Straight-line distance in miles from the insured location to the nearest coastline. Used for wind and storm surge rating factors and CAT accumulation management in coastal territories.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Wind Rating; AIR/RMS Hurricane CAT Models

attributes.name: distance_to_fire_station_miles
attributes.description: Distance in miles from the insured location to the nearest responding fire station. Key input to ISO Public Protection Classification (PPC) and fire rating factor determination.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Public Protection Classification (PPC); ISO Commercial Lines Manual

attributes.name: earthquake_zone
attributes.description: Seismic hazard zone classification (0-4) for the insured location per ISO or USGS standards. Zone 4 is highest seismic risk. Used for earthquake rating and PML modeling.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Earthquake Rating; USGS Seismic Hazard Maps; AIR/RMS CAT Models

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the insured location became active and covered under the associated policy. Marks the start of the location's coverage period for premium earning and loss reporting.
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter; Duck Creek Policy; NAIC Statutory Reporting

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which coverage for the insured location expires or is scheduled to end. Null for open-ended locations. Used for renewal processing and earned premium calculation.
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter; Duck Creek Policy; NAIC Statutory Reporting

attributes.name: flood_zone
attributes.description: FEMA National Flood Insurance Program (NFIP) flood zone designation for the insured location (e.g., AE, X, VE). Determines flood coverage eligibility, mandatory purchase requirements, and rating.
attributes.references: FEMA NFIP Flood Insurance Rate Maps (FIRM); NFIP; State DOI

attributes.name: geocode_quality
attributes.description: Precision level of the geocoded coordinates for the insured location. Rooftop is highest precision; zip_centroid is lowest. Affects CAT model confidence and rating accuracy.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Geocoding Standards; AIR/RMS CAT Modeling Guidelines

attributes.name: itv_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of the insured building value to the estimated full replacement cost. Values below 1.0 indicate underinsurance (coinsurance exposure). Used in UW review and coinsurance penalty calculation.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk ITV Guidelines; ISO Commercial Lines Manual Coinsurance Clause

attributes.name: latitude
attributes.description: WGS-84 decimal-degree latitude of the insured location centroid. Used for CAT modeling, PML estimation, flood zone determination, and proximity-to-hazard scoring.
attributes.references: WGS-84 Geodetic Standard; ISO/Verisk Geocoding; AIR/RMS CAT Models

attributes.name: location_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code assigned to the insured location, used on policy declarations pages and bordereaux submissions to identify the premises.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Location Coding Standards; Guidewire PolicyCenter Location object

attributes.name: location_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name or description of the insured premises (e.g., 'Main Street Warehouse', 'Downtown Office'). Used on declarations pages and loss reports.

attributes.name: location_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the insured location record. Active locations are covered under a policy; inactive or expired locations are no longer in force.

attributes.name: location_type
attributes.description: Classification of the insured premises by operational role: primary business site, secondary site, storage facility, temporary, mobile, or other. Drives rating and coverage eligibility.

attributes.name: longitude
attributes.description: WGS-84 decimal-degree longitude of the insured location centroid. Used alongside latitude for CAT modeling, PML estimation, and hazard proximity analysis.
attributes.references: WGS-84 Geodetic Standard; ISO/Verisk Geocoding; AIR/RMS CAT Models

attributes.name: naics_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: North American Industry Classification System Code (NAICS Code)
attributes.description: Six-digit NAICS code describing the primary business activity conducted at the insured location. Used for commercial lines classification, GL rating, and regulatory statistical reporting.
attributes.references: US Census Bureau NAICS; ISO/Verisk Commercial Lines Manual; NAIC Statistical Reporting

tag_set.value: North American Industry Classification System Code (NAICS Code)

attributes.name: number_of_stories
attributes.description: Total number of above-ground floors in the primary structure at the insured location. Influences fire, wind, and earthquake rating factors and PML calculations.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk COPE; ISO Commercial Lines Manual

attributes.name: occupancy_type
attributes.description: ISO occupancy classification describing how the insured building is used (e.g., office, retail, manufacturing, habitational). Core COPE attribute driving underwriting and rating. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk COPE Occupancy Classes; ISO Commercial Lines Manual; NAIC

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: US ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the insured location. Used for territory rating, CAT zone assignment, protection class lookup, and NAIC statutory reporting.
attributes.references: USPS ZIP Code Standards; ISO/Verisk Territory Rating; NAIC

attributes.name: protection_class
attributes.description: ISO Public Protection Classification (PPC) rating from 1 (best) to 10 for the insured location. Core COPE attribute reflecting fire suppression capability; directly impacts property premium.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Public Protection Classification (PPC); ISO Commercial Lines Manual

attributes.name: roof_material
attributes.description: Primary material used in the roof covering (e.g., asphalt shingle, metal, tile, built-up). Affects wind, hail, and fire rating factors and claim severity estimates. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: promote to reference product]
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Wind and Hail Rating; IBHS Fortified Standards

attributes.name: roof_type
attributes.description: Geometric shape or style of the roof on the primary structure. Influences wind and hail rating factors, particularly in CAT-exposed territories. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: flat|gable|hip|mansard|gambrel|shed|other — 7 candidates stripped; promote to reference
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Wind Rating; IBHS Fortified Standards; Duck Creek Rating

attributes.name: roof_year
attributes.description: Four-digit year the roof was last replaced or substantially renovated. Used for wind and hail rating credits/surcharges and underwriting eligibility decisions.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Wind Rating; Guidewire PolicyCenter; Duck Creek Rating

attributes.name: sic_code
attributes.description: Four-digit SIC code for the business activity at the insured location. Legacy classification used alongside NAICS for workers compensation, GL rating, and older policy systems.
attributes.references: OSHA SIC Manual; ISO/Verisk Commercial Lines Manual; NCCI WC Classification

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Native identifier of the insured location record in the originating system of record (e.g., Guidewire PolicyCenter location GUID or Duck Creek location key). Enables lineage tracing.
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter; Duck Creek Policy; Snowflake Data Lineage

attributes.name: sprinkler_type
attributes.description: Type of automatic fire sprinkler system installed at the insured location. Part of COPE protection assessment; presence and type provide rating credits and reduce fire PML.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk COPE Protection; NFPA 13; ISO Commercial Lines Manual

attributes.name: territory_code
attributes.description: Insurer-assigned or ISO-defined rating territory code for the insured location. Determines territory-specific rate factors for property, auto, and liability lines of business.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Territory Rating; State DOI Rate Filings; Guidewire PolicyCenter

attributes.name: tiv
attributes.description: Aggregate insured value across all coverages at this location including building, contents, and business income. Key metric for PML, reinsurance cession, and CAT accumulation management.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk TIV Standards; NAIC Statutory Reporting; AIR/RMS CAT Models

attributes.name: total_area_sqft
attributes.description: Total gross floor area of the insured structure in square feet. Used for ITV (Insurance to Value) validation, replacement cost estimation, and premium rating.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk COPE; ITV Guidelines; Guidewire PolicyCenter

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the insured location record. Used for change tracking, incremental data loads, and audit compliance.
attributes.references: SOX Compliance; NAIC Data Governance; Guidewire PolicyCenter Audit

attributes.name: valuation_method
attributes.description: Method used to value the insured property: Replacement Cost Value (RCV), Actual Cash Value (ACV), agreed value, or functional replacement. Determines claim settlement basis.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk Property Valuation; ISO Commercial Lines Manual; NAIC

attributes.name: wind_pool_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the insured location is eligible for placement in a state wind pool or beach and windstorm plan due to coastal exposure. Affects market availability and pricing.
attributes.references: State Wind Pool Plans; State Departments of Insurance; NAIC

attributes.name: year_built
attributes.description: Four-digit calendar year in which the primary structure at the insured location was originally constructed. Used for age-of-building rating factors and replacement cost estimation.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk COPE; Guidewire PolicyCenter Building object; Duck Creek Rating

products.name: scheduled_item
products.description: Individually scheduled personal or commercial property items (jewelry, fine art, equipment, tools). Stores item description, agreed value, appraisal date, serial number, and blanket vs scheduled coverage flag.

attributes.name: scheduled_item_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each individually scheduled property item record in the P&C policy administration system.

attributes.name: policy_coverage_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific coverage line (e.g., Inland Marine, Scheduled Personal Property) under which this item is scheduled.

attributes.name: insured_vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_vehicle. Business justification: Scheduled personal property items can be associated with vehicles for coverage purposes (e.g., electronics, tools stored in vehicle, items stolen from vehicle). Optional FK.

attributes.name: photo_document_id
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the photographic documentation of the scheduled item stored in the document management system (e.g., OpenText, FileNet) for claims and underwriting.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent policy under which this scheduled item is insured.

attributes.name: actual_cash_value_amount
attributes.description: Actual cash value of the scheduled item calculated as RCV less depreciation. Used for ACV settlement basis claims and reserve adequacy assessment.
attributes.references: ISO Inland Marine; NAIC Statutory Reporting; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: agreed_value_amount
attributes.description: The agreed value (AV) of the scheduled item as established at policy inception or renewal, representing the maximum insured amount payable at total loss without depreciation.
attributes.references: ISO Inland Marine; Guidewire PolicyCenter; NAIC Statutory Reporting

attributes.name: agreed_value_currency
attributes.description: ISO 4217 three-letter currency code for the agreed value amount (e.g., USD, CAD, GBP).
attributes.references: ISO 4217; NAIC Statutory Reporting; US GAAP

attributes.name: annual_premium_amount
attributes.description: Annual written premium (WP) allocated to this scheduled item, used for premium allocation, earned premium (EP) calculation, and profitability analysis.
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter; Duck Creek Rating; NAIC Statutory Reporting; US GAAP

attributes.name: appraisal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent professional appraisal of the scheduled item was conducted. Used to assess appraisal currency and trigger re-appraisal workflows.
attributes.references: ISO Inland Marine; Guidewire PolicyCenter; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: appraisal_expiry_date
attributes.description: Date on which the current appraisal expires and a new appraisal is required to maintain agreed value coverage. Typically 2-5 years from appraisal date per carrier guidelines.
attributes.references: ISO Inland Marine; State DOI Regulations; Guidewire PolicyCenter

attributes.name: appraisal_value_amount
attributes.description: Most recent professionally appraised market value of the scheduled item, used to validate agreed value adequacy and insurance-to-value (ITV) compliance.
attributes.references: ISO Inland Marine; Verisk Rating Content; ITV Standards

attributes.name: appraiser_certification_number
attributes.description: Professional certification or license number of the appraiser, used to validate appraiser credentials for underwriting and claims purposes.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations; ISO Inland Marine

attributes.name: appraiser_name
attributes.description: Name of the certified appraiser or appraisal firm that conducted the most recent valuation of the scheduled item.
attributes.references: ISO Inland Marine; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: blanket_group_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the blanket coverage group to which this item belongs when is_blanket_covered is True. Used to aggregate items sharing a single blanket limit.

attributes.name: coverage_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the item is covered under a scheduled (individual item limit), blanket (group limit), or floater (open perils, no deductible) coverage arrangement.
attributes.references: ISO Inland Marine; Guidewire PolicyCenter; NAIC

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this scheduled item record was first created in the policy administration system, used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which coverage for this scheduled item becomes effective on the policy. May differ from policy effective date if item was added mid-term via endorsement.
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter; Duck Creek Policy; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: endorsement_number
attributes.description: Reference number of the policy endorsement (ENDT) through which this scheduled item was added, modified, or removed from the policy.
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter; Duck Creek Policy; ISO DEC Page Standards

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which coverage for this scheduled item expires. Typically aligns with policy expiration but may differ for mid-term removals or endorsements.
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter; Duck Creek Policy; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: is_away_from_premises
attributes.description: Indicates whether coverage extends to the scheduled item when it is away from the insured premises (worldwide coverage). True = worldwide; False = premises only.

attributes.name: is_blanket_covered
attributes.description: Indicates whether this item is covered under a blanket limit shared with other items rather than an individual scheduled limit. True = blanket; False = individually scheduled.

attributes.name: iso_class_code
attributes.description: ISO/Verisk classification code assigned to the scheduled item type, used for statistical reporting, rate filings, and NAIC statutory reporting.
attributes.references: ISO ISONet; Verisk Rating Content; NAIC Statutory Reporting

attributes.name: item_category
attributes.description: High-level category classifying the type of scheduled property item for underwriting, rating, and statutory reporting. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: jewelry|fine_art|camera|musical_instrument|silverware|sports_equipment|collectible|tools_equipment|other — promote
attributes.references: ISO Inland Marine Classification; NAIC Statutory Reporting; Verisk Rating Content

attributes.name: item_deductible_amount
attributes.description: Per-item deductible amount applicable to this scheduled item. Many scheduled item endorsements carry a zero deductible; this field captures exceptions.
attributes.references: ISO Inland Marine; Guidewire PolicyCenter; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Full narrative description of the scheduled item including make, model, material, distinguishing features, and any other underwriting-relevant details.
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter; ISO Inland Marine; Verisk Rating Content

attributes.name: item_name
attributes.description: Short descriptive name or title of the scheduled item as it appears on the policy schedule (e.g., 'Diamond Engagement Ring', 'Leica M11 Camera').

attributes.name: item_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric identifier assigned to this scheduled item on the declarations page (DEC) and endorsement schedule.
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter; Duck Creek Policy; ISO DEC Page Standards

attributes.name: item_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the scheduled item on the policy. Drives coverage eligibility and claims adjudication.

attributes.name: item_type
attributes.description: Granular sub-type within the item category (e.g., 'engagement ring' under jewelry, 'oil painting' under fine art) used for detailed rating and claims adjudication.
attributes.references: ISO Inland Marine Classification; Guidewire PolicyCenter

attributes.name: lob_code
attributes.description: NAIC or carrier-defined line of business (LOB) code under which this scheduled item is reported (e.g., Inland Marine, Homeowners, Commercial Package).
attributes.references: NAIC Statutory Reporting; ISO ISONet; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: location_description
attributes.description: Narrative description of the primary location where the scheduled item is kept or stored (e.g., 'primary residence safe', 'bank vault', 'studio'). Used for risk assessment.
attributes.references: ISO Inland Marine; Guidewire PolicyCenter; COPE Standards

attributes.name: make
attributes.description: Manufacturer or brand name of the scheduled item (e.g., 'Rolex', 'Steinway', 'Canon') used for valuation and claims settlement.

attributes.name: model
attributes.description: Model name or number of the scheduled item as specified by the manufacturer, used for replacement cost valuation and claims.

attributes.name: purchase_date
attributes.description: Date on which the insured originally purchased or acquired the scheduled item, used for depreciation calculation and ACV determination.

attributes.name: purchase_price_amount
attributes.description: Original purchase price paid by the insured for the scheduled item, used as a baseline for valuation, ITV assessment, and claims settlement reference.

attributes.name: rate_per_hundred
attributes.description: Insurance rate expressed as cost per $100 of agreed value, used by the rating engine to calculate the annual premium for this scheduled item.
attributes.references: ISO ISONet; Verisk Rating Content; Duck Creek Rating

attributes.name: removal_date
attributes.description: Date on which the scheduled item was removed from the policy via endorsement (ENDT), triggering a pro-rata premium adjustment and coverage termination.
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter; Duck Creek Policy; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: removal_reason
attributes.description: Reason code for removal of the scheduled item from the policy. Used for underwriting analysis and portfolio management. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: sold|lost|stolen|destroyed|gifted|insured_request|underwriting_decision|other — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: replacement_cost_value_amount
attributes.description: Estimated cost to replace the scheduled item with a new item of like kind and quality at current market prices. Used for RCV settlement basis claims.
attributes.references: ISO Inland Marine; Verisk Rating Content; NAIC Statutory Reporting

attributes.name: serial_number
attributes.description: Manufacturer serial number or unique physical identifier of the scheduled item, used for theft recovery, subrogation, and claims verification.
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter; ISO Inland Marine; NIST SP 800-53

attributes.name: storage_type
attributes.description: Classification of the primary storage arrangement for the scheduled item, used for risk rating and underwriting guidelines compliance.
attributes.references: ISO Inland Marine; Verisk Rating Content; Guidewire PolicyCenter

attributes.name: underwriting_notes
attributes.description: Free-text underwriting notes or conditions associated with this scheduled item, capturing special risk considerations, inspection requirements, or coverage restrictions.

attributes.references: NAIC Model Law on Actuarial Opinion and Memorandum; SAP SSAP No. 36

attributes.name: alae_reserve_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) Reserve Amount
attributes.description: Reserve for Allocated Loss Adjustment Expenses directly attributable to specific claims, such as defense costs and expert fees. Reported separately per NAIC Schedule P.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 55; CAS Statement of Principles

tag_set.value: Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) Reserve Amount

attributes.name: appointed_actuary_credential
attributes.description: Professional credential of the Appointed Actuary (e.g., FCAS, MAAA). Required for NAIC actuarial opinion qualification and state DOI regulatory filings.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Law on Actuarial Opinion and Memorandum; CAS Qualification Standards

attributes.name: appointed_actuary_name
attributes.description: Full name of the Appointed Actuary who signed the Statement of Actuarial Opinion for this reserve evaluation, as required by NAIC Model Law.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Law on Actuarial Opinion and Memorandum; SAP SSAP No. 36

attributes.name: cat_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the total reserve attributable to catastrophe (CAT) events as designated by ISO/PCS or internal CAT codes. Reported separately for NAIC CAT exhibits and reinsurance recoverable analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC CAT Reporting; ISO/PCS Catastrophe Designation; SAP SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: company_naic_code
attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC company code identifying the legal insurance entity for which reserves are evaluated. Required for statutory filings and Schedule P exhibits.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; NAIC Company Database

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reserve evaluation record was first created in the data platform. Supports audit trail, SOX compliance, and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: ep_amount
attributes.description: Gross earned premium for the accident year and LOB as of the evaluation date. Denominator for ULR and LR calculations in actuarial reserve adequacy testing.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 53; FASB ASC 944-605

attributes.name: evaluation_date
attributes.description: The as-of date for which loss reserves are evaluated, typically the last day of the reporting quarter or year-end. Anchors all reserve positions and development triangles.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; FASB ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: evaluation_period_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether this evaluation is a quarterly, annual, interim, or special (e.g., CAT event-driven) reserve review cycle.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; IFRS 17 para. 40

attributes.name: evaluation_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric identifier assigned to this reserve evaluation cycle, used in actuarial opinion filings, NAIC Schedule P submissions, and bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: evaluation_status
attributes.description: Current workflow state of the reserve evaluation, from initial draft through actuarial sign-off, management approval, and statutory filing. Drives sign-off and audit controls.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; SAP SSAP No. 55

attributes.name: gross_case_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Total gross (before reinsurance) outstanding case reserve amount as of the evaluation date, representing the estimated liability for known reported claims. Expressed in USD.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 55; FASB ASC 944-40

attributes.name: gross_ibner_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Incurred But Not Enough Reported (IBNER) Reserve Amount
attributes.description: Gross IBNER component of the total IBNR reserve, representing development on known claims where current case reserves are estimated to be inadequate.
attributes.references: CAS Statement of Principles on Loss Reserving; NAIC Schedule P

tag_set.value: Gross Incurred But Not Enough Reported (IBNER) Reserve Amount

attributes.name: gross_ibnr_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Reserve Amount
attributes.description: Gross IBNR reserve amount as of the evaluation date, covering losses incurred but not yet reported to the insurer. Includes pure IBNR and IBNER components.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 55; CAS Statement of Principles

tag_set.value: Gross Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Reserve Amount

attributes.name: gross_total_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Sum of gross case reserves and gross IBNR/IBNER as of the evaluation date. Represents the total gross reserve position before reinsurance recoverables.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 55; FASB ASC 944-40

attributes.name: incurred_losses_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative gross incurred losses (paid plus case reserves) as of the evaluation date for the accident year and LOB. Primary input to the Bornhuetter-Ferguson and chain-ladder methods.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; CAS Statement of Principles on Loss Reserving

attributes.name: lob_description
attributes.description: Human-readable description of the Line of Business corresponding to lob_code, such as 'Commercial General Liability' or 'Workers Compensation'.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; ISO/Verisk Rating Content

attributes.name: loss_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of incurred losses to earned premium as of the evaluation date. Distinct from ULR in that it uses incurred-to-date rather than ultimate estimates. Used in combined ratio reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; FASB ASC 944; A.M. Best Rating Criteria

attributes.name: net_case_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Net (after reinsurance cession) outstanding case reserve amount as of the evaluation date. Reflects the insurer's retained liability on known reported claims.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 55; IFRS 17

attributes.name: net_ibnr_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Net Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Reserve Amount
attributes.description: Net IBNR reserve amount after reinsurance recoverables as of the evaluation date. Used for net reserve adequacy testing and statutory surplus calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 55; IFRS 17

tag_set.value: Net Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Reserve Amount

attributes.name: net_total_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Total net reserve position (case + IBNR) after reinsurance recoverables as of the evaluation date. Key metric for statutory surplus and solvency reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 55; IFRS 17 para. 40

attributes.name: opinion_type
attributes.description: The type of actuarial opinion rendered on reserve adequacy: reasonable, deficient, excessive, qualified, or no opinion. Directly reported in NAIC statutory filings.
attributes.references: NAIC Model Law on Actuarial Opinion and Memorandum; SAP SSAP No. 36

attributes.name: paid_losses_to_date
attributes.description: Cumulative gross losses paid from policy inception through the evaluation date for the accident year and LOB. Used as the base for loss development triangle construction.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; ISO/Verisk Loss Development Factors

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The year in which the policies generating the evaluated losses were written or incepted. Supports policy-year loss development analysis alongside accident-year triangles.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; ISO/Verisk Rating Content

attributes.name: prior_evaluation_date
attributes.description: The as-of date of the immediately preceding reserve evaluation for the same accident year and LOB. Used to compute period-over-period reserve development.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P Part 2; CAS Statement of Principles on Loss Reserving

attributes.name: reserve_basis
attributes.description: The basis on which reserves are evaluated and triangles are constructed: accident year, policy year, report year, or calendar year. Determines triangle structure for Schedule P.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; CAS Statement of Principles on Loss Reserving

attributes.name: reserve_development_amount
attributes.description: Change in total reserve estimate from the prior evaluation period to the current evaluation date. Positive indicates adverse development; negative indicates favorable development.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P Part 2; CAS Statement of Principles on Loss Reserving

attributes.name: reserving_system_source
attributes.description: The actuarial reserving system from which this evaluation record was sourced (e.g., Milliman Arius, Willis Towers Watson ResQ). Supports data lineage and audit traceability.
attributes.references: SOX Section 302/404; NAIC Data Quality Standards

attributes.name: ri_recoverable_amount
attributes.description: Estimated reinsurance recoverable on unpaid losses and LAE as of the evaluation date. Equals gross total reserve minus net total reserve. Reported on NAIC Schedule F.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; SAP SSAP No. 62R; FASB ASC 944-310

attributes.name: schedule_p_line
attributes.description: The specific NAIC Schedule P line (e.g., Line 1 - Homeowners, Line 5 - CGL) to which this reserve evaluation maps for statutory annual statement filing purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: ulae_reserve_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Unallocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ULAE) Reserve Amount
attributes.description: Reserve for Unallocated Loss Adjustment Expenses not directly tied to individual claims, such as general claims department overhead. Estimated via Kittel or similar methods.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule P; SAP SSAP No. 55; CAS Statement of Principles

tag_set.value: Unallocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ULAE) Reserve Amount

attributes.name: ulr
attributes.description: Ratio of the actuarial ultimate loss estimate to earned premium for the accident year and LOB. Key actuarial adequacy metric: ULR = ultimate_loss_estimate / ep_amount.
attributes.references: CAS Statement of Principles on Loss Reserving; NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: ultimate_loss_estimate
attributes.description: Actuarially estimated ultimate loss amount for the accident year and LOB as of the evaluation date. Derived from loss development methods (chain-ladder, BF, Cape Cod).
attributes.references: CAS Statement of Principles on Loss Reserving; NAIC Schedule P

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this reserve evaluation record. Used for incremental data loads, change tracking, and audit compliance in the Databricks Silver layer.

products.name: reservespayments_claim_payment
products.description: Junction table for the many-to-many relationship between claims and payments. Captures payment allocation per claim, coverage part, payment type (indemnity, ALAE, MedPay, PIP), and net-of-recovery amount.

attributes.name: reservespayments_claim_payment_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate primary key for the claim-payment junction record. Identifies a single allocation of a payment to a specific claim and coverage part.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Foreign key reference to the parent claim record. Links the payment allocation to the specific loss event being indemnified.

attributes.name: currency_id

attributes.name: insured_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_entity. Business justification: Entity-level payment history drives experience modification calculations, loss-sensitive pricing adjustments, dividend calculations, and large deductible program reconciliation

attributes.name: insured_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_location. Business justification: Claim payments must be allocated to specific locations to calculate territorial loss costs, support rate filings, analyze loss patterns by construction type, and reconcile cat

attributes.name: insured_vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_vehicle. Business justification: Auto claim payments require vehicle linkage for total loss settlement validation, salvage proceeds reconciliation, and vehicle-level loss history tracking for renewal rating and

attributes.name: part_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific coverage part (e.g., BI, PD, MedPay, PIP, ALAE) under which this payment allocation is made. Drives statutory and financial reporting.
attributes.references: ISO Coverage Forms; NAIC Annual Statement Lines

attributes.name: payee_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party record of the payment recipient. Links to the party master for payee name, tax ID, and address used on the disbursement instrument.

attributes.name: user_account_id
attributes.description: Reference to the employee or adjuster who approved this payment allocation. Required for claims authority audit trail and SOX segregation-of-duties compliance.
attributes.references: SOX; Guidewire ClaimCenter; Internal Claims Authority Matrix

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: Four-digit calendar year in which the loss event occurred. Primary dimension for actuarial loss development triangles and IBNR reserve estimation per NAIC Schedule P.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P; Milliman Arius; Willis Towers Watson ResQ

attributes.name: accounting_date
attributes.description: Date on which this payment allocation is recognized in the general ledger. May differ from payment_date due to period-end cutoffs and accrual adjustments.
attributes.references: US GAAP ASC 944; SAP/STAT; Oracle Financials GL

attributes.name: allocated_gross_amount
attributes.description: Gross dollar amount of the payment allocated to this claim and coverage part before deducting recoveries, SIR, or deductibles. Basis for GWP loss ratio calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; US GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: allocation_number
attributes.description: Human-readable business identifier for this claim-payment allocation line. Used in bordereaux, adjuster notes, and payment reconciliation reports.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Workflow approval state for this payment allocation. Payments above authority thresholds require supervisor or management approval before disbursement per SOX controls.
attributes.references: SOX; Guidewire ClaimCenter; Internal Claims Authority Matrix

attributes.name: approval_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the payment allocation was approved by the authorized approver. Supports SOX audit trail and claims payment timeliness regulatory reporting.
attributes.references: SOX; State DOI Prompt Payment Regulations; Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: bank_clearance_date
attributes.description: Date the payment instrument cleared the issuing bank account. Confirms actual cash outflow for treasury management and outstanding check reconciliation.

attributes.name: cat_event_code
attributes.description: ISO or internal CAT event identifier linking this payment to a declared catastrophe (e.g., hurricane, wildfire, flood). Enables CAT loss aggregation and PML reporting.

attributes.name: check_number
attributes.description: Check number or EFT/wire reference number assigned by the bank or payment processor. Used for bank reconciliation, stop-payment requests, and audit trail.

attributes.name: cost_center_code
attributes.description: Internal cost center to which this payment is attributed for management accounting and expense allocation purposes. Supports departmental P&L reporting.
attributes.references: Oracle Financials GL; SAP FI; Internal Management Accounting

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this claim-payment junction record was first created in the system. Used for audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance.

attributes.name: deductible_offset_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the gross payment amount withheld or offset against the insured's applicable deductible or SIR for this coverage part. Reduces insurer net payment.
attributes.references: ISO Policy Forms; NAIC; Guidewire PolicyCenter

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: GL account code to which this payment allocation is posted in the financial ledger. Ensures correct statutory and GAAP financial statement classification.
attributes.references: Oracle Financials GL; SAP FI; US GAAP ASC 944; SAP/STAT

attributes.name: is_cat_loss
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this payment is associated with a declared catastrophe event. Drives CAT XL reinsurance cession and regulatory CAT reporting.

attributes.name: is_large_loss
attributes.description: Flag indicating whether this payment exceeds the insurer's large-loss threshold, triggering enhanced management review, facultative reinsurance consideration, and actuarial flagging.
attributes.references: Internal UW Guidelines; Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC

attributes.name: lob_code
attributes.description: NAIC or internal line-of-business code (e.g., HO, AUTO, GL, WC, CPP) classifying the policy under which this payment is made. Required for statutory Schedule P reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule P; ISO

attributes.name: loss_date
attributes.description: Date on which the underlying loss event occurred. Denormalized here for statutory accident-year reporting and actuarial loss development triangle construction.

attributes.name: net_of_ri_amount
attributes.description: Net payment amount retained by the insurer after deducting reinsurance recoverables. Equals net_payment_amount minus reinsurance_recoverable_amount. Key NWP metric.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F; IFRS 17; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: net_payment_amount
attributes.description: Net dollar amount paid on this allocation after subtracting recoveries, SIR, and deductible offsets. Equals allocated_gross_amount minus recovery_amount and deductible_offset_amount.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; US GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text adjuster or examiner notes describing the basis for this payment allocation, coverage determination rationale, or special handling instructions.

attributes.name: payment_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the payment was issued or disbursed to the payee. Used for cash-basis accounting, statutory reporting, and aging analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; US GAAP ASC 944; Oracle Financials AP

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Instrument used to disburse the payment: physical check, electronic funds transfer (EFT), wire transfer, bank draft, or virtual card. Used for treasury and AP reconciliation.
attributes.references: Oracle Financials AP; NACHA; PCI DSS

attributes.name: payment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of this payment allocation. Tracks whether the disbursement is pending approval, issued, cleared by the bank, voided, stopped, or returned.

attributes.name: payment_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the nature of the payment: indemnity (loss), ALAE, ULAE, MedPay, PIP, or recovery (subrogation/salvage). Drives statutory line-of-business reporting.

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: Four-digit year in which the policy that generated this claim was effective. Used for policy-year loss development analysis distinct from accident-year triangles.

attributes.name: recovery_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount recovered via subrogation, salvage, or other recovery channels applied against this allocation. Reduces net loss incurred on the claim.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; Guidewire ClaimCenter Subrogation

attributes.name: reinsurance_recoverable_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the gross payment amount recoverable from reinsurers under applicable treaty or facultative (FAC) agreements. Used in cession bordereaux and NWP calculation.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Schedule F; IFRS 17; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: report_date
attributes.description: Date the claim was first reported to the insurer (FNOL date). Used for report-year loss development and IBNR actuarial analysis alongside the loss date.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; Guidewire ClaimCenter FNOL

attributes.name: reserve_type
attributes.description: Identifies the reserve category this payment draws against: case reserve (OCR), IBNR, IBNER, ULAE reserve, or ALAE reserve. Drives actuarial reserve adequacy reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; Milliman Arius; Willis Towers Watson ResQ

attributes.name: salvage_amount

attributes.name: subrogation_status

attributes.name: transaction_timestamp

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this claim-payment junction record. Supports change data capture, audit trails, and incremental ETL processing.

attributes.name: void_date

attributes.name: insured_entity_id

products.name: recovery_transaction

attributes.name: recovery_transaction_id

attributes.name: claim_id

attributes.name: currency_id
