attributes.name: fac_certificate_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.fac_certificate. Business justification: Subrogation and salvage recoveries on facultatively reinsured claims must identify the fac certificate to allocate recovered amounts between cedant and fac reinsurer.

attributes.name: insured_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_location. Business justification: Subrogation and salvage recoveries must be allocated to locations for net loss ratio calculation, territorial rate adequacy analysis, and cat event loss reconciliation.

attributes.name: insured_vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_vehicle. Business justification: Auto salvage proceeds must reconcile to vehicle valuation, title transfer documentation, and total loss settlement amounts; vehicle linkage enables salvage audit and subrogation

attributes.name: coverage_policy_coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.coverage_policy_coverage. Business justification: Subrogation and salvage recoveries must be credited to the specific coverage that paid the loss for accurate loss ratio calculation, reserve release accounting, and

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insurance policy under which the underlying claim was filed and recovery is pursued.

attributes.name: recovered_payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservespayments.payment_transaction. Business justification: Recovery transactions (subrogation, salvage, reinsurance recoveries) often relate to specific payment transactions that were previously issued.

attributes.name: reinsurance_cession_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.cession. Business justification: Recovery transactions on ceded policies must identify the specific cession to allocate recovered amounts (subrogation/salvage) between cedant and reinsurer per cession terms.

attributes.name: reinsurance_recoverable_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservespayments.reinsurance_recoverable. Business justification: When recovery_transaction.recovery_type = 'Reinsurance Recovery', it should link to the reinsurance_recoverable master record.

attributes.name: reservespayments_claim_payment_id
attributes.description: Reference to the specific claim payment disbursement that this recovery offsets or partially recovers.

attributes.name: ri_treaty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance treaty or facultative (FAC) certificate under which the reinsurance recoverable is claimed. Null for non-reinsurance recovery types.
attributes.references: SICS / Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; NAIC Schedule F

attributes.name: salvage_item_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservespayments.salvage_item. Business justification: When recovery_transaction.recovery_type = 'Salvage', it should link to the salvage_item master record. This enables tracking which salvage item generated which recovery.

attributes.name: subrogation_case_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservespayments.subrogation_case. Business justification: When recovery_transaction.recovery_type = 'Subrogation', it should link to the subrogation_case master record.

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: Four-digit year in which the underlying loss event (Date of Loss / DOL) occurred. Used for accident-year loss development and actuarial reserving triangles.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: accounting_period
attributes.description: Fiscal accounting period (YYYY-MM) in which the recovery is recognized for financial close and statutory reporting purposes.
attributes.references: Oracle Financials GL; SAP FI; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: at_fault_party_insurer
attributes.description: Name of the liability insurer of the at-fault third party. Used to direct subrogation demands and track inter-company recovery negotiations.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter Subrogation Module; ISO/Verisk CLUE

attributes.name: at_fault_party_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the third party against whom subrogation or recovery action is pursued. Restricted PII when the party is an individual.

attributes.name: at_fault_party_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of the at-fault third party's liability insurance. Used to identify the adverse carrier and track subrogation demand status.

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the recovery transaction was closed, either through full collection, settlement, or write-off. Null if still open.

attributes.name: collection_attorney_firm
attributes.description: Name of the external law firm or collection agency engaged to pursue the recovery action. Used for vendor management and ALAE expense tracking.

attributes.name: collection_expense_amount
attributes.description: Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) incurred to collect this recovery, including attorney fees, investigation costs, and court costs.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; ALAE Definition ISO/Verisk

attributes.name: company_naic_code
attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC company code identifying the writing company entity. Required for statutory financial statements and Schedule F reinsurance reporting.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this recovery transaction record was first created in the system of record. Used for audit trail and data lineage.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger account code to which the recovery proceeds are posted in the financial ledger. Ensures proper accounting treatment per SAP/STAT and US GAAP.
attributes.references: Oracle Financials GL; SAP FI; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP/STAT)

attributes.name: gross_recovery_amount
attributes.description: Total gross amount recovered before deducting collection expenses, attorney fees, or reinsurance shares. Represents the full inbound recovery value.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; US GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: initiated_date
attributes.description: Date on which the recovery action was formally initiated (e.g., subrogation demand letter sent, salvage auction listed, reinsurance proof of loss submitted).

attributes.name: is_cat_event
attributes.description: Indicates whether the underlying claim is associated with a declared catastrophe (CAT) event. Used for CAT loss reporting and CAT XL reinsurance recovery tracking.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk PCS Catastrophe Designations; NAIC CAT Reporting

attributes.name: is_intercompany
attributes.description: Indicates whether this recovery involves an affiliated entity within the same insurance group. Triggers intercompany elimination in consolidated financial statements.
attributes.references: US GAAP ASC 810; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP/STAT); SOX

attributes.name: lob_code
attributes.description: NAIC or internal Line of Business code classifying the coverage under which the claim was filed (e.g., GL, APD, WC, PD, BI). Used for statutory reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Lines of Business; ISO/Verisk

attributes.name: net_recovery_amount
attributes.description: Net recovery amount after deducting collection expenses from gross recovery. Represents the actual benefit to the insurer for loss ratio and reserve release purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; US GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: net_retained_recovery_amount
attributes.description: Recovery amount retained by the insurer after deducting both collection expenses and the reinsurance share. Used for net loss ratio and financial reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; US GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text narrative capturing adjuster comments, negotiation history, legal strategy notes, or other contextual information relevant to this recovery transaction.

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: Four-digit year in which the policy that generated the underlying claim was effective. Used for policy-year loss development and reinsurance treaty year allocation.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; Reinsurance Treaty Terms

attributes.name: recovery_basis
attributes.description: Accounting basis under which the recovery is recognized: cash (when received) or accrual (when probable and estimable). Aligns with statutory vs GAAP reporting.
attributes.references: Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP/STAT); US GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: recovery_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the recovery was received or recognized, used as the principal business event date for accounting and loss reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; US GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: recovery_method
attributes.description: Mechanism by which the recovery proceeds were received: check, wire transfer, ACH, offset against payable, or credit note from reinsurer.

attributes.name: recovery_reference_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric identifier assigned to this recovery transaction, used in bordereaux, correspondence, and statutory reporting.

attributes.name: recovery_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the recovery transaction: open, in collection, collected, closed, or written off. Drives reserve release and cash posting.

attributes.name: recovery_type
attributes.description: Classification of the inbound recovery: subrogation (SubroFT), salvage, reinsurance recoverable, second-injury fund, or other. Drives accounting treatment and reporting.

attributes.name: reserve_release_amount
attributes.description: Amount of outstanding case reserve (OCR) released upon collection or closure of this recovery transaction. Used for reserve development reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; Milliman Arius; Willis Towers Watson ResQ

attributes.name: ri_share_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the gross recovery that must be remitted to reinsurers per treaty or facultative (FAC) agreement terms. Reduces net recovery retained by the cedant.
attributes.references: NAIC Schedule F; Reinsurance Treaty Terms; IFRS 17

attributes.name: second_injury_fund_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code of the Second Injury Fund from which recovery is sought in Workers Compensation (WC) claims. Null for non-WC or non-SIF recovery types.

attributes.name: state_code
attributes.description: Two-letter US state code where the underlying loss occurred or the policy was issued. Required for state-level statutory reporting to Departments of Insurance.
attributes.references: NAIC State Reporting; State Departments of Insurance (DOI)

attributes.name: statute_of_limitations_date
attributes.description: Date by which legal action must be filed to preserve the recovery right. Critical for subrogation diary management and write-off decisions.
attributes.references: State Statutes of Limitations; State Departments of Insurance (DOI)

attributes.name: subrogation_demand_amount
attributes.description: Full demand amount asserted against the at-fault third party in a subrogation (SubroFT) action. May exceed gross recovery if partial collection occurs.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this recovery transaction record. Used for change tracking and incremental ETL.

attributes.name: write_off_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the expected recovery that was written off as uncollectible. Impacts net loss ratio and reserve release calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; US GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: write_off_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why a recovery was written off without full collection: uncollectible, statute expired, negotiated settlement, insolvency, or waived.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

products.name: subrogation_case
products.description: Master record for a subrogation pursuit against a liable third party. Tracks demand amount, collected amount, attorney assignment, statute of limitations date, settlement status, and net recovery after expenses.

attributes.name: subrogation_case_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the subrogation case record on the Databricks Silver Layer.

attributes.name: adjuster_id
attributes.description: Reference to the claims adjuster or subrogation specialist responsible for managing this recovery pursuit.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; Duck Creek Claims; State DOI Adjuster Licensing

attributes.name: attorney_id
attributes.description: Reference to the internal or external attorney assigned to manage litigation or formal legal pursuit of the subrogation case.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying insurance claim from which this subrogation pursuit originates.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Subrogation case financial amounts (demand, collected, settlement) require currency reference for international recoveries and accounting. Replaces currency_code denormalization.

attributes.name: insured_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_location. Business justification: Property subrogation cases require location details (construction type, protection class, occupancy) for liability determination, demand calculation, and recovery potential

attributes.name: insured_vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_vehicle. Business justification: Auto subrogation demands are based on vehicle damage estimates, repair costs, and total loss valuations; vehicle linkage enables demand calculation and recovery tracking.

attributes.name: coverage_policy_coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.coverage_policy_coverage. Business justification: Subrogation pursuit decisions depend on coverage-specific terms: waiver of subrogation endorsements block recovery rights, deductible reimbursement rules vary by coverage.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insurance policy under which the originating claim was covered.

attributes.name: state_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.state. Business justification: Subrogation cases require state reference for statute of limitations, recovery laws, arbitration forum rules, and court jurisdiction. State_code denormalizes state master.

attributes.name: alae_paid_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) Paid Amount
attributes.description: Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense paid on the originating claim, included in the subrogation demand to the extent recoverable.

tag_set.value: Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) Paid Amount

attributes.name: arbitration_filing_date
attributes.description: Date on which the arbitration demand was formally filed with the selected arbitration forum.
attributes.references: AAIS Arbitration Rules; AAA; Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: arbitration_forum
attributes.description: Arbitration forum selected for intercompany or third-party arbitration proceedings (e.g., AAIS, AAA, AICRB).
attributes.references: AAIS Arbitration Rules; AAA; NCCI; ISO/Verisk

attributes.name: attorney_firm_name
attributes.description: Name of the law firm retained to pursue subrogation recovery through litigation or formal legal demand.

attributes.name: case_number
attributes.description: Externally visible alphanumeric identifier assigned to the subrogation case, used in correspondence and bordereaux reporting.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Subrogation Reporting Standards

attributes.name: case_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle state of the subrogation pursuit. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|in_demand|in_litigation|settled|closed_recovered|closed_no_recovery — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; ISO Subrogation Best Practices

attributes.name: case_type
attributes.description: Classification of the subrogation pursuit by line of business or liability theory. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: auto_liability|property_damage|workers_comp|general_liability|product_liability — promote to reference product]

attributes.name: closed_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subrogation case was closed, either upon full recovery, settlement, or determination of no recovery.

attributes.name: collected_amount
attributes.description: Total amount actually collected from the liable third party or their insurer to date across all recovery payments.

attributes.name: court_jurisdiction
attributes.description: State or federal court jurisdiction in which the subrogation lawsuit has been or will be filed.
attributes.references: State DOI; State Civil Procedure Statutes; NAIC

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the subrogation case record was first created in the system of record.

attributes.name: date_of_loss
attributes.description: Date on which the insured loss event occurred, establishing the basis for the subrogation right.

attributes.name: deductible_reimbursed_amount
attributes.description: Portion of the net recovery returned to the insured as reimbursement of their deductible, per policy terms and state law.

attributes.name: demand_amount
attributes.description: Total dollar amount formally demanded from the liable third party or their insurer, inclusive of losses and recoverable expenses.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; ISO Subrogation Best Practices

attributes.name: demand_sent_date
attributes.description: Date on which the formal demand letter was sent to the liable third party or their insurer.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; ISO Subrogation Best Practices

attributes.name: gross_paid_loss_amount
attributes.description: Total indemnity loss amount paid by the insurer on the originating claim, representing the maximum theoretical subrogation recovery base.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; SAP/STAT; US GAAP FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: liability_percentage
attributes.description: Percentage of fault attributed to the liable third party, used to calculate the proportionate recovery demand in comparative negligence states.
attributes.references: State DOI; ISO Subrogation Best Practices; NAIC

attributes.name: litigation_filed_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a lawsuit has been formally filed in court to pursue the subrogation recovery.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; State Civil Procedure Rules

attributes.name: lob_code
attributes.description: NAIC or internal Line of Business code identifying the insurance product line under which the originating claim was filed.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Line of Business Codes

attributes.name: net_recovery_amount
attributes.description: Net recovery after deducting all pursuit expenses from the collected amount. Equals collected_amount minus recovery_expense_amount.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; SAP/STAT; US GAAP FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Free-text field for adjuster or attorney notes documenting key developments, negotiations, and decisions in the subrogation pursuit.

attributes.name: opened_date
attributes.description: Date on which the subrogation case was formally opened and assigned for pursuit.

attributes.name: priority_level
attributes.description: Operational priority assigned to the subrogation case to guide adjuster workload management and pursuit urgency.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; ISO Subrogation Best Practices

attributes.name: pursuit_method
attributes.description: Method selected to pursue recovery from the liable third party, such as demand letter, arbitration, or formal litigation.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; ISO Subrogation Best Practices

attributes.name: recovery_expense_amount
attributes.description: Total expenses incurred in pursuing the subrogation recovery, including attorney fees, court costs, and investigation costs.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; SAP/STAT; US GAAP FASB ASC 944

attributes.name: ri_recoverable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a portion of the subrogation recovery is owed to reinsurers under applicable treaty or facultative agreements.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; SAP/STAT; IFRS 17; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster

attributes.name: ri_recovery_share_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the net subrogation recovery attributable to reinsurers, calculated per treaty or facultative terms.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement; SAP/STAT; Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; IFRS 17

attributes.name: settlement_amount
attributes.description: Agreed settlement amount accepted from the liable third party, which may be less than the full demand amount.

attributes.name: settlement_date
attributes.description: Date on which a settlement agreement was executed with the liable third party or their insurer.

attributes.name: settlement_status
attributes.description: Indicates whether a settlement agreement has been reached with the third party and the extent of that settlement.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; ISO Subrogation Best Practices

attributes.name: statute_of_limitations_date
attributes.description: Deadline by which legal action must be filed to preserve the subrogation right, per applicable state law.
attributes.references: State DOI; State Civil Procedure Statutes; NAIC

attributes.name: third_party_claim_number
attributes.description: Claim number assigned by the at-fault third party's insurer for the corresponding liability claim.

attributes.name: third_party_insurer_name
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier providing liability coverage to the at-fault third party.

attributes.name: third_party_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the liable third party against whom subrogation is being pursued.
attributes.references: GDPR Article 4; NIST SP 800-122; State DOI Privacy Regulations

attributes.name: third_party_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of the at-fault third party's liability insurance, used to facilitate demand and recovery negotiations.

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the subrogation case record.

attributes.name: waiver_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why subrogation pursuit was waived or abandoned, required for regulatory and audit purposes.
attributes.references: NAIC; State DOI; ISO Subrogation Best Practices

products.name: salvage_item
products.description: Tracks physical salvage property taken title to after a total-loss settlement. Records ACV at loss, salvage proceeds, disposal method (auction, scrap), and net salvage recovery credited back to the claim.

attributes.name: salvage_item_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a salvage item record in the reserves and payments domain.

attributes.name: cat_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservespayments.cat_event. Business justification: Salvage items from CAT events need proper FK linkage to cat_event master. The cat_event_code string becomes redundant when FK allows JOIN.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent claim from which this salvage item originated following a total-loss or partial-loss settlement.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Salvage proceeds and valuations require currency reference for auction settlements, accounting entries, and financial reporting. Currency_code denormalizes currency master.

attributes.name: insured_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_location. Business justification: Property salvage items (damaged equipment, inventory, building materials) are tracked by location for disposal coordination, recovery allocation, and net loss calculation.

attributes.name: insured_vehicle_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_vehicle. Business justification: Total loss vehicles require VIN-level salvage tracking for title transfer, auction lot assignment, salvage proceeds reconciliation, and branded title reporting to state DMV.

attributes.name: coverage_policy_coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.coverage_policy_coverage. Business justification: Salvage proceeds must be credited to the specific coverage (typically physical damage/property) for reserve release, loss settlement accounting, and reinsurance recovery

attributes.name: service_vendor_id
attributes.description: Reference to the salvage vendor or disposal service provider in the vendor/party master, used for payment processing and vendor performance tracking.

attributes.name: acv_at_loss

attributes.description: Actual Cash Value (ACV) of the property at the Date of Loss (DOL), representing the pre-loss fair market value used as the basis for total-loss settlement.

attributes.name: adjuster_notes
attributes.description: Free-text notes entered by the claims adjuster regarding the salvage item condition, disposal challenges, vendor negotiations, or other relevant operational details.

attributes.name: auction_lot_number
attributes.description: Lot number assigned by the auction house for salvage items disposed of through auction channels. Used for reconciliation of auction proceeds remittances.

attributes.name: branded_title_flag

attributes.name: company_naic_code

attributes.name: condition_at_title

attributes.name: disposal_cost

attributes.name: disposal_date

attributes.name: environmental_hazard_flag

attributes.name: item_description
attributes.description: Free-text description of the salvage property including make, model, year, condition, and any distinguishing characteristics relevant to valuation and disposal.

attributes.name: item_type

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp

attributes.name: payment_reference_number

attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; ISO Claims Standards

attributes.name: reinsurance_recoverable_flag
attributes.description: Indicates a portion of the approved payment is expected to be recovered from a reinsurance treaty or facultative certificate.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; IFRS 17; US GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: request_date
attributes.description: Calendar date on which the adjuster submitted the payment for supervisory or management approval.
attributes.references: NAIC Claims Handling Standards; Guidewire ClaimCenter

attributes.name: request_timestamp
attributes.description: Precise date and time the payment approval request was submitted, used for SLA tracking and audit trail purposes.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; SOX Section 404 Audit Trail

attributes.name: requested_amount
attributes.description: Gross dollar amount submitted by the adjuster for approval. May differ from final approved amount if partially approved.
attributes.references: NAIC Claims Handling Standards; US GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: ri_recoverable_amount
attributes.description: Estimated dollar amount recoverable from reinsurers on the approved payment, used for net loss reporting and cession bordereaux.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; IFRS 17; US GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: sir_deductible_amount
attributes.description: Dollar amount of the SIR or policy deductible to be applied against the approved payment, reducing the insurer net payment obligation.
attributes.references: ISO Policy Forms; NAIC Annual Statement Instructions

attributes.name: sla_due_date
attributes.description: Target date by which the approver must render a decision per internal SLA or state-mandated prompt payment requirements.
attributes.references: State DOI Prompt Payment Regulations; NAIC Market Conduct Standards

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record that originated this payment approval record (e.g., Guidewire ClaimCenter, Duck Creek Claims).
attributes.references: Pc_Insurance Data Governance Standards; Snowflake Data Warehouse

attributes.name: supporting_document_ref
attributes.description: Reference identifier to the document management system (e.g., OpenText or FileNet) for supporting documentation attached to the approval request.
attributes.references: OpenText ECM; FileNet; NAIC Claims Documentation Standards

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Date and time the payment approval record was last modified, supporting change tracking and data lineage in the Databricks Silver layer.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NIST SP 800-53 Audit Controls

products.name: payee
products.description: Master record of all parties eligible to receive loss payments: claimants, attorneys, medical providers, repair vendors, and mortgagees. Stores payee type, tax ID (SSN/FEIN), banking details, and 1099 reporting flag.

attributes.name: payee_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the payee master record in the reserves and payments domain.

attributes.name: country_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.country. Business justification: International payees require country reference for OFAC screening, tax withholding rules, wire transfer routing, and sanctions compliance. Country_code denormalizes country master.

attributes.name: preferred_currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Payee currency preference drives payment processing, FX conversion decisions, and international wire transfers. Preferred_currency_code denormalizes currency master data.

attributes.name: state_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.state. Business justification: Payee address state is required for 1099 reporting, state tax withholding, escheatment rules, and regulatory compliance. State_code denormalizes state master.

attributes.name: ach_authorization_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payee authorized ACH direct deposit, establishing the NACHA-required authorization record.

attributes.name: address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line for the payee, used for check mailing and 1099 reporting.

attributes.name: address_line2
attributes.description: Secondary address line (suite, unit, floor) for the payee mailing address.

attributes.name: backup_withholding_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether IRS-mandated backup withholding at the statutory rate applies to payments made to this payee.

attributes.name: bank_account_number
attributes.description: Payee bank account number for ACH or wire disbursements. Stored encrypted; used only for EFT payment processing.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules, PCI DSS, NIST SP 800-111

attributes.name: bank_account_type
attributes.description: Type of bank account (checking or savings) used for ACH disbursements to this payee.

attributes.name: bank_name
attributes.description: Name of the financial institution holding the payee bank account, used for remittance documentation.

attributes.name: bank_routing_number
attributes.description: ABA routing transit number identifying the payee financial institution for ACH and wire transfers.
attributes.references: NACHA Operating Rules, Federal Reserve Regulation J

attributes.name: city
attributes.description: City of the payee mailing address used for check delivery and 1099 filing.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the payee master record was first created in the system, establishing the audit trail origin.

attributes.name: dba_name
attributes.description: Trade or operating name used by the payee if different from the legal name. DBA is common for repair vendors and medical providers.

attributes.name: email_address
attributes.description: Primary email address for the payee, used for electronic remittance advice (ERA) delivery and payment notifications.

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payee is a natural person (individual) or a legal entity (organization), driving tax form and name field usage.

attributes.name: first_name
attributes.description: Given name of the individual payee. Populated only when entity_type is individual.

attributes.name: form_1099_type
attributes.description: Specifies the IRS 1099 form variant applicable to this payee (e.g., 1099-MISC for miscellaneous income, 1099-NEC for non-employee compensation).

attributes.name: is_1099_reportable
attributes.description: Indicates whether payments to this payee must be reported to the IRS on Form 1099. Drives annual 1099 extract and filing.

attributes.name: is_attorney
attributes.description: Indicates the payee is a legal representative (attorney or law firm) receiving settlement or fee payments on behalf of a claimant.

attributes.name: is_claimant
attributes.description: Indicates the payee is a first-party or third-party claimant receiving indemnity loss payments.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter, NAIC Claim Reporting Standards

attributes.name: is_medical_provider
attributes.description: Indicates the payee is a licensed medical provider receiving direct payment for bodily injury (BI), PIP, or MedPay claim services.

attributes.name: last_name
attributes.description: Family name of the individual payee. Populated only when entity_type is individual.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the payee as it must appear on checks and IRS 1099 forms. For individuals, this is the full name; for organizations, the registered legal name.
attributes.references: IRS Form 1099, IRS Publication 1220, GDPR Article 4

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: State-issued professional or contractor license number for medical providers, repair vendors, or public adjusters.
attributes.references: State DOI, State Contractor Licensing Boards

attributes.name: license_state
attributes.description: Two-letter state code of the jurisdiction that issued the payee professional or contractor license.
attributes.references: State DOI, State Contractor Licensing Boards

attributes.name: npi_number
attributes.description: CMS-issued National Provider Identifier for medical provider payees. Required for BI, PIP, and MedPay direct payment processing.

attributes.name: number
attributes.description: Externally visible business identifier assigned to the payee, used on checks, EFT remittances, and 1099 filings.

attributes.name: ofac_screen_date
attributes.description: Most recent date on which the payee was screened against the OFAC SDN and consolidated sanctions lists.

attributes.name: ofac_screen_result
attributes.description: Outcome of the most recent OFAC sanctions screening. Confirmed matches block payment disbursement.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List, 31 C.F.R. Part 501, USA PATRIOT Act

attributes.name: ofac_screened_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payee has been screened against the OFAC Specially Designated Nationals (SDN) list prior to payment.
attributes.references: OFAC SDN List, 31 C.F.R. Part 501, USA PATRIOT Act

attributes.name: payee_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the payee record, controlling eligibility to receive loss payments.

attributes.name: payee_type
attributes.description: Categorizes the payee by their role in the claim payment process. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: claimant|attorney|medical_provider|repair_vendor|mortgagee|lienholder|public_adjuster|other — promote to reference product]
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter, Duck Creek Claims, NAIC

attributes.name: payment_block_flag
attributes.description: Indicates that all payments to this payee are currently blocked, typically due to OFAC match, fraud investigation, or legal hold.

attributes.name: payment_block_reason
attributes.description: Reason code explaining why payments to this payee are blocked. Required when payment_block_flag is true.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter, Duck Creek Claims, OFAC

attributes.name: payment_method
attributes.description: Preferred disbursement method for loss payments to this payee (e.g., paper check, ACH direct deposit, wire transfer).
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter, Duck Creek Claims, NACHA Operating Rules

attributes.name: phone_number
attributes.description: Primary contact phone number for the payee, used for payment inquiries and check reissuance coordination.

attributes.name: postal_code
attributes.description: ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the payee mailing address.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Identifies the operational system of record from which this payee record originated (e.g., Guidewire ClaimCenter, Duck Creek Claims).
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter, Duck Creek Claims, Sapiens IDIT

attributes.name: tax_id_type
attributes.description: Classifies the tax_id as SSN (Social Security Number), FEIN (Federal Employer Identification Number), ITIN, or EIN for correct IRS reporting.

attributes.name: tax_identification_number
attributes.description: IRS-issued Tax Identification Number: SSN for individuals or FEIN for organizations. Required for 1099 reporting and OFAC screening.
attributes.references: IRS Publication 1220, IRS Form W-9, 26 U.S.C. § 6041

attributes.name: tin_verification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the payee TIN was last verified through the IRS TIN matching program.
attributes.references: IRS TIN Matching Program, IRS Publication 1281

attributes.name: tin_verified_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the payee TIN has been verified against IRS TIN matching program prior to issuing payment.
attributes.references: IRS TIN Matching Program, IRS Publication 1281

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to the payee master record, supporting audit and data lineage tracking.

attributes.name: w9_received_date
attributes.description: Date on which the IRS Form W-9 was received from the payee, establishing the basis for backup withholding exemption.

attributes.name: w9_received_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether a completed IRS Form W-9 (Request for Taxpayer Identification Number) has been received from the payee.

products.name: reinsurance_recoverable
products.description: Tracks amounts recoverable from reinsurers on paid and reserved losses under treaty and facultative (FAC) agreements. Records cession reference, gross loss, RI share, collected amount, and collectability status.

attributes.name: reinsurance_recoverable_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for each reinsurance recoverable record in the Pc_Insurance lakehouse silver layer.

attributes.name: cat_event_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reservespayments.cat_event. Business justification: Reinsurance recoverables for CAT events need proper FK linkage to cat_event master. The cat_event_code string becomes redundant when FK allows JOIN.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying claim against which this reinsurance recoverable is tracked. Links to the claim master record in ClaimCenter or Duck Creek Claims.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: RI recoverable amounts require currency reference for bordereaux reporting, collection tracking, and multi-currency reinsurance accounting. Currency_code is denormalized.

attributes.name: insured_location_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_location. Business justification: Cat XL reinsurance recoveries are calculated based on location-level PML, treaty attachment points, and loss aggregation by event; location linkage enables cession calculation

attributes.name: lob_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.lob_code. Business justification: RI recoverables must track LOB for treaty application, bordereaux reporting, and reinsurance accounting. Lob_code denormalizes LOB master.

attributes.name: occurrence_loss_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.occurrence_loss. Business justification: Recoverables arising from catastrophic occurrences must link to occurrence_loss for occurrence-level aggregation, treaty exhaustion tracking, and reinstatement premium

attributes.name: coverage_policy_coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.coverage_policy_coverage. Business justification: Reinsurance treaties specify coverage scope, exclusions, and LAE treatment by coverage type.

attributes.name: policy_id
attributes.description: Reference to the insurance policy under which the underlying claim was filed and the reinsurance cession applies.

attributes.name: reinsurer_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurer counterparty (party master) from whom the recoverable amount is due. Supports multi-reinsurer panel structures.

attributes.name: ri_treaty_id
attributes.description: Reference to the reinsurance treaty or facultative (FAC) certificate under which this recoverable is ceded. Null for facultative if a separate fac_certificate_id is used.

attributes.name: state_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.state. Business justification: RI recoverables must track state for unauthorized reinsurer collateral requirements, state-specific credit rules, and regulatory reporting. State_code is denormalized.

attributes.name: treaty_layer_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to reinsurance.treaty_layer. Business justification: Recoverables calculated against multi-layer treaties must identify the specific layer for accurate attachment/exhaustion tracking and layer-specific settlement.

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: The calendar year in which the loss event (date of loss) occurred. Used for actuarial loss development triangles and NAIC statutory Schedule F reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC SAP Schedule F; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: accounting_basis
attributes.description: Accounting framework under which this recoverable is recognized and reported: STAT (Statutory Accounting Principles per NAIC SAP), GAAP (US GAAP ASC 944), or IFRS17 for international entities.
attributes.references: NAIC SAP; US GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17; FASB; IAIS

attributes.name: authorized_reinsurer_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether the reinsurer is authorized (licensed) in the cedant's domicile state. Unauthorized reinsurers require collateral (LOC or trust) per NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; State DOI; NAIC SAP

attributes.name: bordereaux_period
attributes.description: The quarterly or monthly bordereaux reporting period (e.g., 2024-Q1 or 2024-03) in which this recoverable was included in the cession bordereau submitted to the reinsurer.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; SICS; Bordereaux Processing Standard

attributes.name: cat_event_indicator
attributes.description: Flags whether the underlying loss is associated with a catastrophe (CAT) event. Drives CAT XL treaty layer activation, PML tracking, and CAT bond recoverable reporting.
attributes.references: ISO/Verisk PCS CAT Codes; NAIC SAP; NFIP

attributes.name: cession_reference
attributes.description: The cession or bordereau line reference assigned by the reinsurance management system (SICS/ReinsuranceMaster) linking this recoverable to its originating cession transaction.

attributes.name: collateral_held_amount
attributes.description: Amount of collateral (letter of credit, trust fund, or funds withheld) held from the reinsurer to secure the recoverable, required for unauthorized reinsurers under NAIC Credit for Reinsurance rules.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; NAIC SAP Schedule F

attributes.name: collateral_type
attributes.description: Type of collateral arrangement securing the recoverable from an unauthorized reinsurer: letter of credit (LOC), trust fund, funds withheld, cash deposit, or none for authorized reinsurers.
attributes.references: NAIC Credit for Reinsurance Model Law; NAIC SAP Schedule F

attributes.name: collectability_status
attributes.description: Assessment of the likelihood of collecting the outstanding recoverable from the reinsurer. Drives NAIC Schedule F Part 3 aged-debt disclosure and allowance for uncollectible RI.
attributes.references: NAIC SAP Schedule F Part 3; A.M. Best; S&P Rating Agencies

attributes.name: collected_amount
attributes.description: Cumulative amount actually received from the reinsurer to date against this recoverable. Used to compute the outstanding balance and monitor collection performance.
attributes.references: NAIC SAP Schedule F; Oracle Financials AR; SAP FI

attributes.name: company_naic_code
attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC company code of the Pc_Insurance legal entity (cedant) that holds this recoverable. Required for NAIC Schedule F statutory filing and multi-entity group reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC; State Departments of Insurance (DOI); NAIC SAP Schedule F

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this reinsurance recoverable record was first created in the system of record. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements.

attributes.name: date_of_loss
attributes.description: The date on which the insured loss event occurred (DOL). Used to determine treaty year applicability and to match the recoverable to the correct reinsurance period.

attributes.name: dispute_reason
attributes.description: Free-text or coded description of the reason the reinsurer has disputed this recoverable (e.g., coverage interpretation, late reporting, policy conditions). Populated when collectability_status is in_dispute.

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: GL account code in Oracle Financials or SAP FI to which this reinsurance recoverable asset is posted. Supports financial close, balance sheet reconciliation, and SOX controls.
attributes.references: Oracle Financials GL; SAP FI; SOX; US GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: gross_alae_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Gross Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) Amount
attributes.description: Gross ALAE (Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense) incurred on the underlying claim before reinsurance. Included in recoverable calculations where the treaty covers LAE.
attributes.references: NAIC SAP; NAIC Annual Statement; ISO/Verisk

tag_set.value: Gross Allocated Loss Adjustment Expense (ALAE) Amount

attributes.name: gross_loss_amount
attributes.description: Total gross incurred loss amount (paid plus outstanding case reserve) before any reinsurance recovery. Represents the cedant's 100% share prior to cession. Basis for RI share calculation.
attributes.references: NAIC SAP Schedule F; US GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: last_collection_date
attributes.description: Date of the most recent cash receipt from the reinsurer against this recoverable. Used for aged-debt analysis and NAIC Schedule F Part 3 overdue recoverable identification.
attributes.references: NAIC SAP Schedule F Part 3; Oracle Financials AR

attributes.name: outstanding_recoverable_amount
attributes.description: Net amount still due from the reinsurer, calculated as total RI recoverable amount minus collected amount. Key balance sheet asset for STAT and GAAP reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC SAP Schedule F; US GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: The year in which the policy that generated the underlying loss was written or incepted. Used alongside accident year for treaty period matching and bordereaux processing.

attributes.name: recoverable_number
attributes.description: Externally-known business reference number uniquely identifying this recoverable record, used in bordereaux submissions and reinsurer correspondence.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; SICS; Bordereaux Processing Standard

attributes.name: recoverable_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the recoverable. Drives collectability monitoring, aged-debt reporting, and STAT/GAAP balance sheet presentation. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: open|collected|partially_collected|disputed|written_off|closed — promote to reference
attributes.references: NAIC SAP; US GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: recoverable_type
attributes.description: Classifies the nature of the recoverable: paid loss, case reserve (OCR), IBNR, ALAE, ULAE, or salvage/subrogation. Drives actuarial and statutory schedule presentation.
attributes.references: NAIC SAP Schedule F; NAIC Annual Statement; ISO/Verisk

attributes.name: reinsurance_type
attributes.description: Indicates whether the recoverable arises under a proportional/non-proportional treaty arrangement or a facultative (FAC) certificate placed on a specific risk.

attributes.name: reinsurer_credit_rating
attributes.description: A.M. Best or S&P financial strength rating of the reinsurer at the valuation date. Used to assess collectability risk and support NAIC Schedule F Part 3 disclosures.
attributes.references: A.M. Best; S&P Rating Agencies; NAIC SAP Schedule F

attributes.name: reinsurer_naic_code
attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC company code assigned to the reinsurer. Required for NAIC Schedule F statutory reporting and state DOI filings identifying authorized vs. unauthorized reinsurers.
attributes.references: NAIC; State Departments of Insurance (DOI); NAIC SAP Schedule F

attributes.name: retention_amount
attributes.description: The cedant's net retained loss amount after cession, representing the portion of gross loss not recoverable from the reinsurer. Equals gross loss minus RI recoverable loss amount.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; SICS; NAIC SAP Schedule F

attributes.name: ri_recoverable_alae_amount
attributes.description: The ALAE portion of the total reinsurance recoverable, calculated as gross ALAE multiplied by the RI share where the treaty includes LAE coverage.

attributes.name: ri_recoverable_loss_amount
attributes.description: The gross loss amount multiplied by the RI share percentage, representing the total loss amount recoverable from the reinsurer under this cession before any collections.
attributes.references: NAIC SAP Schedule F; US GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: ri_recoverable_total_amount
attributes.description: Sum of RI recoverable loss and RI recoverable ALAE amounts. Represents the total gross amount due from the reinsurer before collections and any collectability adjustments.
attributes.references: NAIC SAP Schedule F; US GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17

attributes.name: ri_share_percent
attributes.description: The percentage of the gross loss ceded to the reinsurer under the applicable treaty or FAC certificate. For QS treaties this is the cession rate; for XOL it reflects the layer participation.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; SICS; NAIC SAP Schedule F

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system of record from which this recoverable record originated (e.g., SICS, Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster, Guidewire ClaimCenter). Supports data lineage.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Standard; Snowflake Data Warehouse

attributes.name: treaty_type
attributes.description: Structure of the reinsurance arrangement: QS (Quota Share), XOL (Excess of Loss), CAT XL (Catastrophe Excess of Loss), surplus share, or facultative-obligatory.
attributes.references: Sapiens ReinsuranceMaster; SICS; NAIC SAP Schedule F

attributes.name: uncollectible_amount
attributes.description: Amount of the outstanding recoverable deemed uncollectible due to reinsurer insolvency, dispute, or credit impairment. Reduces the net asset on the NAIC Schedule F Part 3 aged analysis.
attributes.references: NAIC SAP Schedule F Part 3; US GAAP ASC 944-310; A.M. Best

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to this reinsurance recoverable record. Used for incremental ETL processing, change tracking, and audit trail in the Snowflake lakehouse.
attributes.references: SOX; Internal Data Governance Standard; Snowflake Data Warehouse

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: The as-of date at which the recoverable amounts (gross loss, RI share, collected) are evaluated. Aligns with actuarial valuation periods and quarterly STAT close cycles.
attributes.references: NAIC SAP; US GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17; Milliman Arius; WTW ResQ

products.name: structured_settlement
products.description: Records periodic-payment structured settlement agreements that replace lump-sum indemnity. Captures annuity provider, present value, payment schedule, guarantee period, and assignment to a qualified assignment company.

attributes.name: structured_settlement_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for the structured settlement record. Primary key for this entity.

attributes.name: claim_id
attributes.description: Reference to the underlying claim for which this structured settlement was established in lieu of a lump-sum indemnity payment.

attributes.name: claimant_id
attributes.description: Reference to the party record for the claimant or payee who is the beneficiary of the structured settlement periodic payments.
attributes.references: Guidewire ClaimCenter; NAIC Model Settlement Practices Act

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Structured settlement amounts require currency reference for present value calculation, annuity pricing, and financial reporting. Replaces denormalized currency_code.

attributes.name: insured_entity_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to riskexposure.insured_entity. Business justification: Workers compensation structured settlements require employer entity data for qualified assignment documentation, tax reporting, and experience modification calculation of present

attributes.name: lob_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.lob_code. Business justification: Structured settlements require LOB classification for financial reporting, profitability analysis, and management reporting. Replaces lob_code denormalization.

attributes.name: payment_transaction_id
attributes.description: Reference to the originating payment transaction record that was converted or replaced by this structured settlement agreement.

attributes.name: coverage_policy_coverage_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to coverage.coverage_policy_coverage. Business justification: Structured settlements are established under specific liability coverages (typically bodily injury).

attributes.name: state_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.state. Business justification: Structured settlements require state reference for court approval requirements, state tax treatment, and regulatory compliance. Replaces state_code denormalization.

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the loss event occurred, used for actuarial loss development, statutory reporting, and reserve triangulation.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: accounting_basis
attributes.description: Accounting framework under which the structured settlement liability is measured and reported: Statutory (STAT), US GAAP, or IFRS 17.
attributes.references: Statutory Accounting Principles; US GAAP ASC 944; IFRS 17; FASB

attributes.name: agreement_date
attributes.description: Date on which the structured settlement agreement was formally executed and signed by all parties.
attributes.references: IRC Section 130; NAIC Model Settlement Practices Act

attributes.name: annuity_contract_number
attributes.description: Policy or contract number assigned by the annuity provider for the annuity contract that funds the structured settlement periodic payments.

attributes.name: annuity_cost_amount
attributes.description: Actual premium paid to the annuity provider to fund the structured settlement annuity contract, representing the insurer's cost of settlement.
attributes.references: IRC Section 130; US GAAP ASC 944; Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: annuity_provider_naic_code
attributes.description: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) company code for the annuity provider issuing the structured settlement annuity contract.

attributes.name: annuity_provider_name
attributes.description: Legal name of the life insurance company that issues and funds the annuity contract underlying the structured settlement.
attributes.references: IRC Section 130; NAIC Structured Settlement Model Act

attributes.name: broker_name
attributes.description: Name of the structured settlement consultant or broker who facilitated the placement of the annuity and negotiation of the settlement terms.
attributes.references: NSSTA Best Practices; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: claimant_tax_identification_number
attributes.description: Social Security Number (SSN) or Federal Employer Identification Number (FEIN) of the claimant for IRS tax reporting on structured settlement payments.
attributes.references: IRC Section 130; IRS Form W-9; NIST SP 800-122

attributes.name: cola_rate
attributes.description: Annual cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) rate applied to periodic payments, expressed as a decimal (e.g., 0.0300 for 3%). Zero if no COLA applies.
attributes.references: IRC Section 130; NSSTA; CPI-U (Bureau of Labor Statistics)

attributes.name: company_naic_code
attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC company code for the Pc_Insurance legal entity that is the settling insurer and obligor under this structured settlement.
attributes.references: NAIC Company Database; Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: court_approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which a court of competent jurisdiction approved the structured settlement agreement, required for minor or incapacitated claimants.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations; NAIC Model Settlement Practices Act

attributes.name: court_approval_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether court approval is required for this structured settlement, typically for minor or incapacitated claimants under state law.
attributes.references: State DOI Regulations; NAIC Model Settlement Practices Act; IRC Section 130

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this structured settlement record was first created in the system of record.

attributes.name: date_of_loss
attributes.description: Date on which the insured loss event occurred that gave rise to the claim settled through this structured settlement agreement.

attributes.name: discount_rate
attributes.description: Actuarial discount rate used to calculate the present value of future periodic payments for reserving and financial reporting purposes.
attributes.references: IFRS 17; US GAAP ASC 944; Statutory Accounting Principles; FASB

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the structured settlement becomes binding and periodic payments are scheduled to commence.
attributes.references: IRC Section 130; NAIC Model Settlement Practices Act

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger (GL) account code in Oracle Financials or SAP FI to which the structured settlement liability and annuity cost are posted.
attributes.references: Oracle Financials GL; SAP FI; US GAAP ASC 944; Statutory Accounting Principles

attributes.name: guarantee_period_years
attributes.description: Number of years for which periodic payments are guaranteed regardless of the annuitant's survival, providing a minimum payment floor.
attributes.references: IRC Section 130; NSSTA; NAIC Structured Settlement Model Act

attributes.name: payment_end_date
attributes.description: Date on which the last scheduled periodic payment is due, or null for life-contingent settlements with no fixed end date.

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which periodic payments are disbursed to the claimant under the structured settlement schedule.

attributes.name: payment_start_date
attributes.description: Date on which the first periodic payment under the structured settlement is scheduled to be disbursed to the claimant.

attributes.name: periodic_payment_amount
attributes.description: Base amount of each scheduled periodic payment disbursed to the claimant, before any cost-of-living adjustment (COLA) is applied.

attributes.name: policy_number

tag_set.value: Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Reserve Amount

attributes.name: declaration_date
attributes.description: Date when the catastrophe event was officially declared by the company for internal tracking and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: event_description
attributes.description: Detailed narrative description of the catastrophe event, including meteorological or geological characteristics and impact summary.

attributes.name: event_end_date
attributes.description: Date when the catastrophe event concluded or ceased causing new losses. Nullable for ongoing events.

attributes.name: event_start_date
attributes.description: Date when the catastrophe event began or first caused insured losses.

attributes.name: geographic_scope
attributes.description: Classification of the catastrophe event geographic extent for exposure aggregation and reinsurance triggering.

attributes.name: ibnr_reserve_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Reserve Amount
attributes.description: Actuarial reserve estimate for losses incurred but not yet reported for this catastrophe event, in USD.

tag_set.value: Incurred But Not Reported (IBNR) Reserve Amount

attributes.name: industry_loss_estimate_amount
attributes.description: Estimated total insured loss across the entire insurance industry for this catastrophe event, in USD.

attributes.name: industry_loss_estimate_date
attributes.description: Date when the industry loss estimate was published or last updated.

attributes.name: industry_loss_estimate_source
attributes.description: Organization or entity that provided the industry loss estimate (e.g., ISO/PCS, AIR Worldwide, RMS).

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this catastrophe event record was last modified, reflecting the most recent claim or loss data update.

attributes.name: naic_company_code
attributes.business_glossary_term: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Company Code
attributes.description: Five-digit NAIC company code identifying the legal entity reporting this catastrophe event for statutory purposes.

tag_set.value: National Association of Insurance Commissioners (NAIC) Company Code

attributes.name: cat_event_name
attributes.description: Common name or designation of the catastrophe event (e.g., Hurricane Katrina, California Wildfire 2020).

attributes.name: net_loss_amount
attributes.description: Net incurred loss after reinsurance recoveries for this catastrophe event, in USD.

attributes.name: open_claim_count
attributes.description: Total number of claims associated with this catastrophe event that remain open and under active adjustment.

attributes.name: peril_type
attributes.description: Primary peril or cause of loss associated with the catastrophe event. [ENUM-REF-CANDIDATE: hurricane|tornado|wildfire|earthquake|flood|hail|winter_storm|wind|other — 9 candidates stripped; promote to reference product]

attributes.name: pml_tier
attributes.description: Classification tier indicating the severity of the catastrophe event relative to the company's PML thresholds for reinsurance attachment.

attributes.name: reported_claim_count
attributes.description: Total number of claims reported and associated with this catastrophe event as of the last update.

attributes.name: ri_recoverable_amount
attributes.description: Total reinsurance recoverable amount expected or collected for losses from this catastrophe event, in USD.

attributes.name: source_system_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the operational system that created or manages this catastrophe event record (e.g., ClaimCenter, ISO/PCS feed).

attributes.name: stat_reporting_required_flag
attributes.description: Indicates whether this catastrophe event meets thresholds requiring special statutory reporting to state insurance departments.

attributes.name: total_case_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Sum of outstanding case reserves held for all open claims associated with this catastrophe event, in USD.

attributes.name: total_incurred_loss_amount
attributes.description: Sum of paid losses and outstanding case reserves for all claims associated with this catastrophe event, in USD.

attributes.name: total_paid_loss_amount
attributes.description: Sum of all loss payments made on claims associated with this catastrophe event, in USD.

attributes.name: ulae_amount
attributes.description: Estimated unallocated loss adjustment expenses attributable to this catastrophe event, in USD.

products.name: reserve_study
products.description: Master reference table for reserve_study. Referenced by reserve_study_id.

attributes.name: reserve_study_id
attributes.description: Primary key for reserve_study

attributes.name: accident_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which the insured loss events occurred, used for cohort-based reserve analysis.

attributes.name: actuarial_method
attributes.description: Actuarial technique applied in the study, such as chain ladder, Bornhuetter-Ferguson, expected loss ratio, or frequency-severity methods.

attributes.name: actuary_credential
attributes.description: Professional actuarial designation held by the responsible actuary, such as Fellow or Associate of the Casualty Actuarial Society.

attributes.name: actuary_name
attributes.description: Name of the credentialed actuary responsible for preparing and certifying the reserve study.

attributes.name: alae_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Reserve for loss adjustment expenses directly attributable to individual claims, such as legal and expert fees.

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date when the reserve study was formally approved by management or the board for financial reporting.

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or identifier of the executive or committee that approved the reserve study.

attributes.name: case_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Sum of case reserves established by claims adjusters for known open claims as of the valuation date.

attributes.name: claim_count
attributes.description: Number of claims included in the reserve study population for the specified cohort and coverage.

attributes.name: closed_claim_count
attributes.description: Number of claims closed with payment or without payment as of the valuation date.

attributes.name: confidence_level
attributes.description: Statistical confidence level percentage associated with the reserve estimate, typically ranging from 50 to 95 percent.

attributes.name: coverage_type
attributes.description: Specific coverage or peril analyzed in the reserve study, providing granular segmentation within the line of business.

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the reserve study record was first created in the system.

attributes.name: currency_code
attributes.description: Three-letter ISO 4217 currency code for all monetary amounts in the reserve study.

attributes.name: data_quality_rating
attributes.description: Actuarial assessment of the quality and credibility of the underlying claims data used in the reserve study.

attributes.name: expected_loss_ratio
attributes.description: Ratio of expected ultimate losses to earned premium, used in Bornhuetter-Ferguson and expected loss ratio methods.

attributes.name: ibnr_claim_count_estimate
attributes.description: Estimated number of claims incurred but not yet reported to the insurer as of the valuation date.

attributes.name: ibnr_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Actuarial estimate of reserves for claims incurred but not yet reported, including development on known claims.

attributes.name: line_of_business
attributes.description: Insurance line of business covered by this reserve study, such as commercial auto, workers compensation, general liability, or property.

attributes.name: loss_development_factor
attributes.description: Multiplicative factor applied to paid or incurred losses to project ultimate losses, derived from historical development patterns.

attributes.name: modified_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the reserve study record was last modified or updated.

attributes.name: open_claim_count
attributes.description: Number of claims still open and unpaid as of the valuation date, requiring case reserves.

attributes.name: paid_loss_amount
attributes.description: Total loss payments made to date for the claims in the study population, excluding loss adjustment expenses.

attributes.name: policy_year
attributes.description: Policy year for which reserves are being studied, representing the year policies were written.

attributes.name: prior_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Reserve amount from the previous valuation or study, used for development and variance analysis.

attributes.name: report_year
attributes.description: Calendar year in which claims were reported, used for report-year-based reserve development analysis.

attributes.name: reserve_change_amount
attributes.description: Net change in reserve estimate from the prior valuation, indicating reserve strengthening or release.

attributes.name: reserve_estimate_amount
attributes.description: Total reserve amount estimated by the study, representing the actuarial best estimate of unpaid claim liabilities.

attributes.name: reserve_high_estimate_amount
attributes.description: Upper bound of the reserve estimate range, representing an optimistic or high-severity scenario.

attributes.name: reserve_low_estimate_amount
attributes.description: Lower bound of the reserve estimate range, representing a conservative or pessimistic scenario.

attributes.name: salvage_subrogation_amount
attributes.description: Anticipated recoveries from salvage and subrogation, reducing net reserve requirements.

attributes.name: study_effective_date
attributes.description: Date when the reserve study becomes effective for financial reporting and reserving purposes.

attributes.name: study_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date when the reserve study is superseded or no longer applicable for reserving purposes.

attributes.name: study_name
attributes.description: Descriptive name of the reserve study for identification and reporting purposes.

attributes.name: study_notes
attributes.description: Free-text commentary and assumptions documented by the actuary regarding methodology, data quality, or special considerations.

attributes.name: study_number
attributes.description: Business identifier for the reserve study, externally referenced in actuarial reports and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: study_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the reserve study indicating its approval and publication state.

attributes.name: study_type
attributes.description: Classification of reserve study: case reserves, incurred but not reported, unallocated loss adjustment expense, allocated loss adjustment expense, salvage and subrogation, or unallocated reserves.

attributes.name: ulae_reserve_amount
attributes.description: Reserve for loss adjustment expenses not attributable to individual claims, such as claims department overhead.

attributes.name: ultimate_loss_estimate_amount
attributes.description: Actuarial estimate of total losses that will ultimately be paid for the cohort, including paid and unpaid amounts.

attributes.name: valuation_date
attributes.description: As-of date for which reserves are estimated and reported in this study.
