products.name: producers_producer
products.description: SSOT master for every licensed insurance producer (agent or broker) appointed by the carrier. Owns producer identity, NPN, FEIN/SSN, entity type, and active status across all lines of business.
products.reference: NAIC Producer Master / AgentSync / Vertafore Sircon

attributes.name: producers_producer_id
attributes.description: Unique identifier for the producers_producer data product.

attributes.name: agency_id
attributes.description: Reference to the parent agency or brokerage firm with which this individual producer is affiliated. Null for agency-level producer records. Supports hierarchical commission rollup.

attributes.name: commission_schedule_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to producers.commission_schedule. Business justification: Producer master record references default commission schedule via string code. Adding proper FK enables referential integrity.

attributes.name: state_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.state. Business justification: Producer licensing and regulatory compliance require tracking the producer's domicile state. State DOI governs producer appointments, license renewals, and regulatory filings.

attributes.name: aml_certification_date
attributes.description: Date on which the producer completed the most recent AML training certification. Used to track certification currency and trigger renewal reminders.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML Program Requirements; NAIC Model AML Regulation

attributes.name: anti_money_laundering_certified
attributes.description: Indicates whether the producer has completed required Anti-Money Laundering (AML) training certification. Mandatory for producers handling certain commercial and high-value personal lines.
attributes.references: FinCEN AML Program Requirements; NAIC Model AML Regulation

attributes.name: appointment_effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which the carrier's appointment of the producer became effective with the state Department of Insurance. Marks the start of the producer's authority to solicit business.

attributes.name: appointment_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the producer's appointment with the carrier. Determines whether the producer is authorized to bind new business or service existing policies.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; State DOI Appointment Filing Requirements

attributes.name: appointment_termination_date
attributes.description: Date on which the carrier's appointment of the producer was terminated or expired. Null if the appointment is currently active. Required for NAIC termination filings.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; State DOI Termination Filing

attributes.name: background_check_date
attributes.description: Date on which the most recent background check was completed for this producer. Used to determine if a refresh is required per carrier compliance policy.
attributes.references: State DOI Licensing Requirements; AgentSync / Vertafore Sircon

attributes.name: background_check_status
attributes.description: Status of the most recent background check conducted on the producer as part of the carrier's onboarding and ongoing compliance program. Required by many state DOIs.
attributes.references: State DOI Licensing Requirements; NAIC Market Conduct; AgentSync

attributes.name: binding_authority_granted
attributes.description: Indicates whether the producer has been granted binding authority to commit the carrier to coverage without prior underwriting review. Drives workflow routing in PolicyCenter.

attributes.name: binding_authority_limit
attributes.description: Maximum single-risk premium or total insured value (TIV) in USD that the producer is authorized to bind without prior underwriting approval. Null if no binding authority is granted.
attributes.references: Carrier Underwriting Guidelines; Guidewire PolicyCenter Binding Authority

attributes.name: business_address_city
attributes.description: City of the producer's principal place of business address.
attributes.references: State DOI Licensing Requirements; USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: business_address_line1
attributes.description: Primary street address line of the producer's principal place of business. Used for regulatory correspondence, appointment filings, and commission payment mailing.
attributes.references: State DOI Licensing Requirements; USPS Addressing Standards

attributes.name: business_address_state
attributes.description: Two-letter USPS state code for the producer's principal place of business. Used for state-level regulatory filings and geographic distribution analytics.

attributes.name: business_address_zip
attributes.description: US ZIP or ZIP+4 postal code for the producer's principal place of business. Used for geographic territory assignment and regulatory jurisdiction determination.

attributes.name: business_email
attributes.description: Primary business email address for the producer. Used for policy documents, commission statements, regulatory notices, and system-generated alerts from PolicyCenter or Duck Creek.
attributes.references: State DOI Licensing Requirements; NIST SP 800-122

attributes.name: business_phone
attributes.description: Primary business telephone number for the producer's office. Used for underwriting communication, claims coordination, and regulatory correspondence.

attributes.name: contingent_commission_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether the producer is eligible for contingent or profit-sharing commission based on loss ratio and volume performance thresholds defined in the producer agreement.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Annual Statement; Carrier Producer Agreement

attributes.name: continuing_education_compliant
attributes.description: Indicates whether the producer is current on state-mandated continuing education (CE) credit hours required for license renewal. Sourced from NIPR or AgentSync CE tracking.
attributes.references: State DOI CE Requirements; NIPR; AgentSync

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when the producer record was first created in the producer management system. Audit trail field aligned with SOX data lineage requirements.

attributes.name: dba_name
attributes.description: Trade or DBA name under which the producer operates if different from the legal name. Used on customer-facing documents and marketing materials.

attributes.name: e_and_o_carrier
attributes.description: Name of the insurance carrier providing the producer's Errors and Omissions (E&O) professional liability coverage. Carrier requires active E&O as a condition of appointment.
attributes.references: Carrier Producer Appointment Requirements; State DOI E&O Requirements

attributes.name: e_and_o_expiration_date
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Policy Expiration Date
attributes.description: Expiration date of the producer's E&O professional liability policy. Compliance monitoring must alert before expiration to prevent appointment suspension.

tag_set.value: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Policy Expiration Date

attributes.name: e_and_o_limit_amount
attributes.business_glossary_term: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Coverage Limit Amount
attributes.description: Per-occurrence coverage limit of the producer's E&O professional liability policy in USD. Carrier may require a minimum limit as a condition of appointment for certain LOBs.

tag_set.value: Errors and Omissions (E&O) Coverage Limit Amount

attributes.name: e_and_o_policy_number
attributes.description: Policy number of the producer's active E&O professional liability insurance. Tracked to verify continuous coverage as a condition of maintaining carrier appointment.

attributes.name: entity_type
attributes.description: Classification of the producer as an individual person or a business entity. Drives licensing requirements, commission structures, and regulatory reporting.

attributes.name: fein
attributes.description: IRS-issued Federal Employer Identification Number for agency or corporate producer entities. Used for 1099 commission tax reporting and financial ledger payables processing.

attributes.name: last_updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent update to the producer record in the producer management system. Used for change data capture (CDC) and data lineage tracking in the Snowflake lakehouse.

attributes.name: legal_name
attributes.description: Full legal name of the producer as registered with the state Department of Insurance. For individuals, this is the full personal name; for agencies, the registered business name.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; State DOI Licensing Requirements

attributes.name: license_class
attributes.description: Classification of the producer's license type as defined by the domicile state DOI (e.g., Property, Casualty, Personal Lines, Commercial Lines, Life, Accident & Health).
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; State DOI License Classifications

attributes.name: license_expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which the producer's domicile state insurance license expires. Carrier compliance systems must monitor this date to suspend appointment before license lapse.
attributes.references: State DOI Licensing Requirements; AgentSync / Vertafore Sircon

attributes.name: license_number
attributes.description: State-issued insurance producer license number in the producer's domicile state. Distinct from NPN; used for state-level regulatory filings and appointment verifications.

attributes.name: lines_of_authority
attributes.description: Pipe-delimited list of lines of authority (LOA) for which the producer is licensed and appointed (e.g., Property|Casualty|Personal Lines). Governs which LOBs the producer may solicit.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; State DOI Lines of Authority

attributes.name: managing_general_agent_code
attributes.description: Code identifying the Managing General Agent (MGA) or wholesale broker through whom this producer accesses the carrier's products, if applicable. Used for MGA commission override calculations.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct; Carrier MGA Agreement

attributes.name: npn
attributes.description: NIPR-assigned National Producer Number uniquely identifying the producer across all US states. Mandatory for regulatory licensing verification and NAIC reporting.

attributes.name: onboarding_date
attributes.description: Date on which the producer completed the carrier's onboarding process and was first activated in the producer management system. Used for tenure analysis and cohort reporting.

attributes.name: preferred_lob
attributes.description: Primary line of business (LOB) in which the producer specializes or generates the majority of written premium (e.g., Personal Auto, Homeowners, Commercial GL, BOP, WC). Used for territory and product alignment.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Lines of Business; ISO LOB Classifications

attributes.name: producer_code
attributes.description: Carrier-assigned internal code uniquely identifying the producer within the policy administration system (Guidewire PolicyCenter or Duck Creek Policy). Used on policy DEC pages and commission statements.

attributes.name: producer_type
attributes.description: Distribution channel classification indicating whether the producer is a captive agent (exclusive), independent agent, wholesale broker, or direct writer. Drives commission tier and appointment rules.

attributes.name: ssn_last4
attributes.business_glossary_term: Social Security Number (SSN) Last Four Digits
attributes.description: Last four digits of the individual producer's SSN retained for identity verification and 1099 tax reporting. Full SSN must not be stored per PCI DSS and NIST SP 800-122 data minimization.

tag_set.value: Social Security Number (SSN) Last Four Digits

attributes.name: surplus_lines_licensed

attributes.name: uw_authority_level

products.name: commission_schedule
products.description: Reference schedule defining base commission rates, contingent bonus tiers, and override percentages by LOB, policy transaction type (NB, REN), and producer tier. SSOT for commission rate configuration.

attributes.name: commission_schedule_id
attributes.description: Unique surrogate identifier for a commission schedule record. Primary key for the commission_schedule product in the producers domain.

attributes.name: currency_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.currency. Business justification: Commission schedules specify rates and thresholds in specific currencies. Multi-currency commission calculation and financial reporting require currency reference.

attributes.name: lob_code_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.lob_code. Business justification: Commission rates are structured by line of business due to varying risk profiles and market dynamics. Commission calculation and profitability analysis require LOB reference.

attributes.name: state_id
attributes.description: Foreign key linking to shared.state. Business justification: Commission schedules vary by state due to regulatory requirements and market conditions. Commission calculation and regulatory filing require state reference. Removes denormalized state_code.

attributes.name: superseded_by_commission_schedule_id
attributes.description: Reference to the commission_schedule_id of the newer schedule that replaced this one. Null if this is the current active version. Supports schedule lineage and audit trails.
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance and Audit Standards

attributes.name: approval_date
attributes.description: Date on which this commission schedule received final approval from the designated authority. Null if approval is still pending or the schedule was rejected.

attributes.name: approval_status
attributes.description: Internal approval workflow status for this commission schedule. Schedules must be approved before activation. Supports SOX-compliant change management and audit trail requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; Internal Governance and Change Management Policy

attributes.name: approved_by
attributes.description: Name or employee identifier of the underwriting or finance authority who approved this commission schedule for activation. Required for SOX audit trail and governance compliance.

attributes.name: base_commission_rate
attributes.description: Standard base commission rate expressed as a decimal percentage of Written Premium (WP) earned by the producer for qualifying policies under this schedule.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Model Regulation; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: cancellation_chargeback_rate
attributes.description: Rate at which previously paid commission is charged back to the producer upon policy cancellation (CANC). Applied to the unearned premium returned to the policyholder.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Model Regulation; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: channel
attributes.description: Distribution channel to which this commission schedule applies: independent agent, captive agent, direct, broker, or digital. Enables channel-specific commission differentiation.
attributes.references: NAIC Market Conduct Annual Statement; State DOI Distribution Channel Reporting

attributes.name: combined_ratio_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum permissible Combined Ratio (CR) for the producer's portfolio to qualify for profit-sharing or contingent bonus. Incorporates both Loss Ratio (LR) and Expense Ratio (ER).
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: contingent_bonus_rate
attributes.description: Additional contingent bonus rate payable on top of the base commission when the producer meets profitability or volume thresholds defined in the bonus tier configuration.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: created_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp when this commission schedule record was first created in the system. Supports audit trail, data lineage, and SOX compliance requirements.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NIST SP 800-53 Audit and Accountability

attributes.name: dac_eligible
attributes.description: Indicates whether commissions paid under this schedule qualify as Deferred Acquisition Costs (DAC) for GAAP accounting purposes under ASC 944, requiring capitalization and amortization.
attributes.references: GAAP ASC 944-30 Deferred Acquisition Costs; FASB

attributes.name: commission_schedule_description
attributes.description: Free-text narrative describing the business purpose, eligibility criteria, and special conditions of this commission schedule. Used in producer agreements and internal documentation.

attributes.name: effective_date
attributes.description: Date on which this commission schedule becomes active and applicable to qualifying producer transactions. Policies bound on or after this date are subject to these rates.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: endorsement_rate
attributes.description: Commission rate applied to mid-term endorsement (ENDT) transactions that generate additional premium. Applied to the net additional premium resulting from the endorsement.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: expiration_date
attributes.description: Date on which this commission schedule ceases to be applicable. Null indicates an open-ended schedule with no defined end date. Superseded schedules retain history.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: filing_reference
attributes.description: State DOI filing reference number or SERFF tracking number associated with the regulatory submission of this commission schedule. Null if no filing is required.
attributes.references: SERFF (System for Electronic Rate and Form Filing); State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: gl_account_code
attributes.description: General Ledger (GL) account code in Oracle Financials or SAP FI to which commission expenses under this schedule are posted. Ensures accurate financial reporting and cost allocation.
attributes.references: Oracle Financials GL Chart of Accounts; SAP FI; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: loss_ratio_threshold
attributes.description: Maximum permissible Loss Ratio (LR) expressed as a decimal that the producer's book must not exceed to remain eligible for contingent bonus or profit-sharing commission under this schedule.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; Actuarial Standards of Practice (ASOP)

attributes.name: max_volume_premium
attributes.description: Upper Written Premium (WP) volume cap in USD above which this schedule tier no longer applies and the producer advances to the next tier. Null indicates no upper cap.
attributes.references: Internal Underwriting and Producer Agreement Standards

attributes.name: measurement_period
attributes.description: Time period over which producer volume, loss ratio, and profitability metrics are measured to determine eligibility and payout under this commission schedule.
attributes.references: Internal Producer Agreement Standards; NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure

attributes.name: min_policy_count
attributes.description: Minimum number of in-force policies the producer must maintain during the measurement period to qualify for this commission schedule or contingent bonus tier.

attributes.name: min_volume_premium
attributes.description: Minimum Written Premium (WP) volume in USD that a producer must generate within the measurement period to qualify for this commission schedule or contingent bonus tier.
attributes.references: Internal Underwriting and Producer Agreement Standards

attributes.name: new_business_rate
attributes.description: Specific commission rate applied to New Business (NB) policy transactions when the schedule differentiates NB from renewal rates. Overrides base_commission_rate for NB transactions.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Model Regulation; GAAP ASC 944 DAC

attributes.name: notes
attributes.description: Internal operational notes or comments regarding exceptions, amendments, or special handling instructions for this commission schedule. Not exposed in producer-facing documents.

attributes.name: override_rate
attributes.description: Override percentage applied to the base commission rate for managing general agents or hierarchical producers who earn a spread on sub-producer business.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: payment_frequency
attributes.description: Frequency at which earned commissions under this schedule are calculated and disbursed to the producer, e.g., monthly, quarterly, semi-annual, or annual.
attributes.references: Internal Finance and Accounts Payable Standards; Oracle Financials AP

attributes.name: producer_tier
attributes.description: Producer performance or appointment tier to which this schedule applies. Tier determines eligibility for enhanced base rates, contingent bonuses, and override percentages.
attributes.references: AgentSync / Vertafore Sircon Producer Tier Classification

attributes.name: producer_type
attributes.description: Type of producer entity this schedule governs: independent agent, broker, Managing General Agent (MGA), MGA-E, or surplus lines broker. Affects regulatory disclosure and payout rules.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Licensing Model Act; State DOI Regulations

attributes.name: profit_sharing_rate
attributes.description: Rate applied to the producer's eligible profit base to calculate profit-sharing commission. Payable when the producer's book achieves profitability targets defined by loss and combined ratio thresholds.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Model Regulation; GAAP ASC 944

attributes.name: regulatory_filing_required
attributes.description: Indicates whether this commission schedule must be filed with the applicable State Department of Insurance (DOI) prior to use, as required by state producer compensation disclosure regulations.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Model Regulation; State DOI Filing Requirements

attributes.name: renewal_rate
attributes.description: Specific commission rate applied to Renewal (REN) policy transactions. Typically lower than the New Business (NB) rate, reflecting reduced acquisition cost for retained policies.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Model Regulation; GAAP ASC 944 DAC

attributes.name: schedule_code
attributes.description: Externally-known alphanumeric code uniquely identifying this commission schedule, used in producer agreements, bordereaux, and system configuration references.
attributes.references: AgentSync / Vertafore Sircon Producer Management Standard

attributes.name: schedule_name
attributes.description: Human-readable name describing this commission schedule, used in producer-facing documents, commission statements, and reporting dashboards.
attributes.references: AgentSync / Vertafore Sircon Producer Management Standard

attributes.name: schedule_status
attributes.description: Current lifecycle status of the commission schedule: draft (pending approval), active (in force), suspended (temporarily halted), expired (past end date), or superseded (replaced by newer version).
attributes.references: Internal Data Governance Policy; AgentSync Producer Management

attributes.name: schedule_type
attributes.description: Classifies the commission schedule as base, contingent, override, profit-sharing, or bonus. Drives calculation logic and payout eligibility rules in the commission engine.
attributes.references: NAIC Producer Compensation Disclosure Model Regulation

attributes.name: stat_expense_code
attributes.description: NAIC statutory expense code used to classify commission payments in the Annual Statement Underwriting and Investment Exhibit. Required for statutory financial reporting.
attributes.references: NAIC Annual Statement Instructions; Statutory Accounting Principles (SAP/STAT)

attributes.name: transaction_type
attributes.description: Policy transaction type to which this schedule applies: New Business (NB), Renewal (REN), Endorsement (ENDT), Cancellation (CANC), or Reinstatement. Enables differential commission rates by transaction.
attributes.references: Guidewire PolicyCenter Transaction Type Standard; Duck Creek Policy

attributes.name: updated_timestamp
attributes.description: Timestamp of the most recent modification to this commission schedule record. Used for change detection, incremental data loads, and audit trail maintenance.
attributes.references: SOX Section 404; NIST SP 800-53 Audit and Accountability

attributes.name: version_number
attributes.description: Monotonically incrementing version number for this commission schedule. Enables tracking of rate changes and amendments over time while preserving historical rate configurations.

attributes.name: endorsement_id

attributes.name: accounting_date
